release.name: Lithe v0.6.5
release.body:
## 中文

本次更新扩展 Agent、插件和远程文件编辑，改进终端、Git 与键盘导航。

### 下载

- [项目主页](https://github.com/1lck/Lithe-IDEA)
- [macOS Apple Silicon](https://github.com/1lck/Lithe-IDEA/releases/download/v0.6.5/Lithe-0.6.5-arm64.dmg)
- [macOS Intel](https://github.com/1lck/Lithe-IDEA/releases/download/v0.6.5/Lithe-0.6.5-x86_64.dmg)
- [Windows x64](https://github.com/1lck/Lithe-IDEA/releases/download/v0.6.5/Lithe-0.6.5-windows-x64.exe)
- [全部下载文件](https://github.com/1lck/Lithe-IDEA/releases/tag/v0.6.5)

### 重点更新

本次更新内容如下。

#### ✨ 新功能

- macOS 新增项目创建向导，可使用插件提供的项目模板。
- macOS 新增 Linux SSH 连接管理，支持测试连接、浏览远程目录及编辑保存文件。
- macOS 的 Claude 与 Codex 官方订阅支持添加多个账号并手动切换。
- Claude 可选择官方订阅或 API Key 连接方式。
- Agent 设置新增 Codex 与 Claude Code 的 Hook 管理，可配置工具运行前后的动作。
- macOS 的 HTML 预览支持网页导航、缩放、页内查找、打印和导出 PDF。
- macOS 插件可提供原生界面和项目模板，SVN 改为独立社区插件。
- Windows 新增声明式插件的磁盘安装、启用管理、设置和独立网页工具窗口。
- Windows 支持在项目树和搜索结果按 F4 打开焦点文件，并保留匹配位置。

#### ⚡ 改进

- macOS 数据库改为从插件市场的 Lithe Store 安装 Database，已有连接与历史可迁入插件。
- Agent 对话改进长历史加载，并将每轮思考和工具过程合并为默认折叠的过程区。
- macOS Agent 显示工具返回的图片缩略图，支持点击放大和查看后台任务状态。
- macOS 改进 Claude Desktop 会话中的计划、待办事项与后台任务展示。
- 完善 Agent、技能、全局指令和 MCP 设置，Windows 补充会话与运行状态能力。
- macOS 设置窗口拖动与工作台更新分离，统一常用输入框、树列表和按钮样式。
- macOS 项目树按名称自然排序，隐藏路径可用同一模式列表管理。
- Windows 终端支持拖动停靠活动栏，并改善搜索快捷键。
- 统一双端中英文资源，减少界面语言切换后的翻译遗漏。

#### 🛠 修复

- 关闭项目、退出或更新前确认并结束运行服务，避免遗留后台进程。
- Git 推送使用正确的上游目标，大型未跟踪目录按目录汇总显示。
- Windows 修正 Diff 新增行颜色、文件导航顺序和预览标签行为。
- Windows 的 Ctrl+Z 优先恢复键盘移动后的光标位置。
- Java 方法调用补全默认留空参数，避免插入不需要的实参。
- macOS 终端退出 shell 后自动关闭标签，并同步主题及终端程序背景色。
- macOS 隐藏标题栏后仍可使用原生全屏，插件详情不再超出面板边界。
- macOS 恢复压缩过的 Claude 会话时保留较早用户消息中的截图。
- 修正 Agent 正文留白和 AI 设置排序。

### 升级说明

- macOS：打开对应架构的 DMG，将 Lithe.app 拖入“应用程序”；使用数据库的用户升级后请从 Lithe Store 安装 Database。
- Homebrew：新版配方更新后，运行 `brew update && brew upgrade --cask lithe`。
- Windows：下载并运行 x64 安装包。

### 兼容性与已知问题

- macOS 需要 13.0 或更高版本，提供 Apple Silicon 与 Intel 安装包；Windows 安装包面向 x64。
- macOS 使用临时签名，尚无 Developer ID 签名或公证；Windows 安装包尚无 Authenticode 签名，自动更新使用独立签名。
- 数据库插件目前仅支持 macOS；首次使用请从 Lithe Store 安装 Database，旧版“直到重启”保存的密码需重新输入。
- macOS 远程开发目前仅接入 Linux SSH 文件浏览、编辑与保存，远程 Git、搜索、终端和构建尚未接入。
- macOS 的多账号界面、原生插件界面与项目向导尚未在 Windows 提供；Windows 插件构建能力与市场来源仍有限制。
- 部分 Agent、插件和真实 WebView2 交互仍待完整实机验收，不代表所有功能已双端一致。

如果 macOS 提示无法打开 Lithe.app，请在“应用程序”中按住 Control 点按应用并选择“打开”；如果仍被阻止，可在终端执行 `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Lithe.app`。仅对可信来源的应用使用。

[查看完整变更](https://github.com/1lck/Lithe-IDEA/compare/v0.6.4...v0.6.5)

---

## English

This release expands Agent, plugin, and remote file workflows, with improvements to terminals, Git, and keyboard navigation.

### Downloads

- [Project homepage](https://github.com/1lck/Lithe-IDEA)
- [macOS Apple Silicon](https://github.com/1lck/Lithe-IDEA/releases/download/v0.6.5/Lithe-0.6.5-arm64.dmg)
- [macOS Intel](https://github.com/1lck/Lithe-IDEA/releases/download/v0.6.5/Lithe-0.6.5-x86_64.dmg)
- [Windows x64](https://github.com/1lck/Lithe-IDEA/releases/download/v0.6.5/Lithe-0.6.5-windows-x64.exe)
- [All downloads](https://github.com/1lck/Lithe-IDEA/releases/tag/v0.6.5)

### Highlights

Changes are grouped below.

#### ✨ New features

- macOS adds a project creation wizard with templates supplied by plugins.
- macOS adds Linux SSH connection management, connection tests, remote folder browsing, and file editing and saving.
- macOS supports multiple Claude and Codex subscription accounts with manual switching.
- Claude connections can use either an official subscription or an API key.
- Agent settings add Codex and Claude Code Hook management for actions around tool execution.
- macOS HTML previews support navigation, zoom, in-page search, printing, and PDF export.
- macOS plugins can provide native interfaces and project templates; SVN is now a separate community plugin.
- Windows adds disk installation, enable/disable controls, settings, and separate web tool windows for declarative plugins.
- Windows adds F4 navigation from the project tree and search results, preserving the focused result location.

#### ⚡ Improvements

- macOS database features move to the Database plugin in Lithe Store, with migration for existing connections and history.
- Agent conversations improve long-history loading and group each turn’s reasoning and tool activity into a collapsed section.
- macOS Agent displays tool-image thumbnails with enlarged previews and shows background-task status.
- macOS improves plans, to-do lists, and background-task presentation in Claude Desktop sessions.
- Agent, skills, global instructions, and MCP settings improve; Windows gains additional conversation and execution-state capabilities.
- macOS separates settings-window dragging from workbench updates and unifies common fields, tree lists, and buttons.
- macOS project trees use natural name sorting, and hidden paths share one pattern list.
- Windows terminals support activity-bar drag docking and improve search shortcuts.
- Shared Chinese and English resources reduce missing translations when switching interface languages.

#### 🛠 Fixes

- Closing projects, quitting, or updating confirms and stops running services to avoid leftover background processes.
- Git pushes use the correct upstream target, and large untracked folders appear as directory summaries.
- Windows fixes added-line colors, file navigation order, and preview-tab behavior in diffs.
- Windows Ctrl+Z prioritizes restoring the cursor position after keyboard navigation.
- Java method-call completion leaves arguments empty instead of inserting unwanted values.
- macOS closes terminal tabs after shell exit and synchronizes themes and terminal-application background colors.
- macOS retains native fullscreen with hidden title bars and keeps plugin details within panel boundaries.
- macOS preserves screenshots from earlier user messages when restoring compacted Claude conversations.
- Fixes Agent message spacing and AI settings ordering.

### Upgrade instructions

- macOS: open the matching DMG and drag Lithe.app to Applications; database users should install Database from Lithe Store after upgrading.
- Homebrew: run `brew update && brew upgrade --cask lithe` after the cask update is available.
- Windows: download and run the x64 installer.

### Compatibility and known issues

- macOS requires 13.0 or later, with Apple Silicon and Intel installers; Windows installers target x64.
- macOS uses ad-hoc signing without Developer ID signing or notarization; Windows installers lack Authenticode signing, while automatic updates use separate signatures.
- The Database plugin currently supports macOS only; install it from Lithe Store, and re-enter passwords previously stored only until restart.
- macOS remote development currently connects Linux SSH file browsing, editing, and saving; remote Git, search, terminals, and builds are not connected.
- The macOS multi-account interface, native plugin interfaces, and project wizard are not yet on Windows; Windows plugin build capabilities and marketplace sources remain limited.
- Some Agent, plugin, and real WebView2 interactions still await complete runtime acceptance; feature parity between platforms remains incomplete.

If macOS says it cannot open Lithe.app, Control-click it in Applications and choose Open. If it is still blocked, run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Lithe.app` in Terminal. Use this only for an app from a source you trust.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/1lck/Lithe-IDEA/compare/v0.6.4...v0.6.5)

### 🙌 感谢贡献者

感谢 [@1lck](https://github.com/1lck), [@arkleselect](https://github.com/arkleselect), [@frankxii](https://github.com/frankxii), [@icefery](https://github.com/icefery), [@milestone-17](https://github.com/milestone-17), [@Mucheen](https://github.com/Mucheen), [@puppyben1](https://github.com/puppyben1), [@xiaoyumuxi](https://github.com/xiaoyumuxi), [@zher52](https://github.com/zher52)。

### 🙌 Contributors

Thanks to [@1lck](https://github.com/1lck), [@arkleselect](https://github.com/arkleselect), [@frankxii](https://github.com/frankxii), [@icefery](https://github.com/icefery), [@milestone-17](https://github.com/milestone-17), [@Mucheen](https://github.com/Mucheen), [@puppyben1](https://github.com/puppyben1), [@xiaoyumuxi](https://github.com/xiaoyumuxi), [@zher52](https://github.com/zher52).

release.name: pi-agent-desktop v0.7.8
release.body:
## Pi Agent Desktop 0.7.8

### New

- **Find in conversation.** Press Ctrl/Cmd+F to search the loaded part of a conversation, with match highlighting, a counter, Enter / Shift+Enter to step through matches and Esc to return to the composer. Matches stay put while a reply is streaming.
- **Choose the terminal shell.** General settings now lets you pick the shell used by "Open in terminal". Windows prefers PowerShell 7, then Windows PowerShell, then CMD; macOS and Linux keep your login shell. The choice applies to new or restarted terminals.
- **Richer replies.** A leading YAML block is shown as a code block instead of disappearing, GitHub alerts (`> [!NOTE]`) render as callouts, long code blocks fold, and code blocks that the reply says were saved to a file get an Open button.
- **Conversation titles.** Title generation shows its progress and gives an actionable message when it fails.

### Improved

- **A calmer look.** Neutral grays, a flat window and sidebar canvas, thinner two-tier borders that stay visible on Retina screens, softer code colors and consistent corner radii. The accent color follows the system. The background presets from 0.7.7 are gone, replaced by this neutral canvas; light, dark and system modes remain.
- Terminals use the workbench's light and dark colors and start faster, and closing a terminal on Windows no longer errors.
- Project and session menus stay inside the window, and delete confirmations are shared and keyboard friendly.
- Line numbers are excluded when you select code.

### Fixed

- A project that is a subfolder of a Git repository no longer shows the parent repository's worktrees in the sidebar.

Bundled components: pi 1.4.0, pi-web 0.10.0.

---

## Pi Agent Desktop 0.7.8

### 新增

- **对话内查找。** 按 Ctrl/Cmd+F 搜索已加载的对话内容：高亮匹配、显示计数，Enter / Shift+Enter 在匹配间跳转，Esc 回到输入框。回复流式输出时，当前匹配位置保持不动。
- **选择终端 Shell。** “通用”设置可选择“在终端中打开”使用的 Shell。Windows 优先 PowerShell 7，其次 Windows PowerShell，再次 CMD；macOS 和 Linux 沿用登录 Shell。新建或重启的终端会使用该选择。
- **更丰富的回复渲染。** 开头的 YAML 块现在以代码块显示而不是消失；支持 GitHub 提示块（`> [!NOTE]`）；长代码块可折叠；回复中说明已保存到文件的代码块会出现“打开”按钮。
- **对话标题生成。** 标题生成会显示进度，失败时给出可操作的提示。

### 改进

- **更平静的外观。** 中性灰、统一的窗口与侧栏纯色底、更细的两档边线（在 Retina 屏上依然清晰）、更柔和的代码配色和统一圆角；强调色跟随系统。0.7.7 的背景预设已移除，由中性底色取代；浅色、深色与跟随系统模式保留。
- 终端使用工作台的明暗配色且启动更快；Windows 上关闭终端不再报错。
- 项目和会话菜单不会超出窗口，删除确认改为共用组件并支持键盘操作。
- 选择代码时不再选中行号。

### 修复

- 位于 Git 仓库子目录的项目，侧栏不再显示父仓库的 worktree。

内置组件版本：pi 1.4.0、pi-web 0.10.0。

release.name: v4.1.1 — Aria2 Next 3.0.9 and Windows Fixes
release.body:
## What's Changed

This release bundles Aria2 Next 3.0.9 for all platforms. Downloads finish without a slow tail, a retried download no longer corrupts its file, and a slow IPv6 route no longer holds a download back. It also fixes the Windows installer and caption buttons, external links, repeated clipboard prompts and RPM upgrades from a beta.

### 🛠 Improvements

- **Aria2 Next 3.0.9** — a slow connection hands its remaining range to idle ones at the end of a download (#762); connections move off an address family that is several times slower, so a broken IPv6 route no longer keeps a download at a crawl; connections that fall far behind are replaced
- **Clipboard** — a copied link is offered once per run, also after the main window is recreated from the tray or the link was already used in the add window (#751)
- **Browser takeover** — when the engine receives a verification page instead of the file, Rayburst takes over from the address the browser actually landed on (rayburst-connect#104)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Fixed corrupted downloads after a retry: the unwritten part of a preallocated file is no longer counted as downloaded, and a server that rejects extra connections with 403 lowers the connection count instead of failing (#767)
- Fixed the Windows installer failing to stop running processes (#756)
- Fixed the caption buttons not reacting to hover or clicks on Windows 10 (#755)
- Fixed links in the update notes opening inside the app; links that leave the app open in the system browser (#764)
- Fixed a window hidden to the tray reappearing when the GNOME session locks (#759)
- Fixed a paused multi-file torrent asking for its file selection again (#754)
- Fixed RPM upgrades from a beta to the stable release being refused as a downgrade (#766)

### 📦 Downloads

| Platform | Architecture          | File                      |
| -------- | --------------------- | ------------------------- |
| macOS    | Apple Silicon · Intel | `.dmg`                    |
| Windows  | x64 · ARM64           | `-setup.exe`              |
| Linux    | x64 · ARM64           | `.AppImage` `.deb` `.rpm` |

release.name: DSH NEXT v2.0.21-next
release.body:
# 中文

本次 Next 更新将上游升级至 DeepSeek Harness v0.2.1-rc.4，优化应用启动速度与窗口状态恢复，升级恢复助手的 Profile 修复、撤销与故障报告能力，支持 `dshfind` 插件索引，并将内置 Agents Anywhere 插件升级至 2.1.0（支持 Codex 会话交接与双端轮流对话、依赖环境重装及历史消息顺序修复）。

DSH NEXT 是社区维护的开源项目，并非 DeepSeek 官方产品。

**上游版本：** [DeepSeek Harness v0.2.1-rc.4](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/releases/tag/dsh-v0.2.1-rc.4)。

## 新增与改进

- **启动速度与窗口体验:** 加快 macOS 无系统代理时的网络探测与启动环境变量加载，并启用前端脚本编译缓存以提升二次启动速度；自动记忆并恢复主窗口的位置、尺寸与最大化状态。
- **恢复助手与 Profile 修复:** “备份并修复当前 Profile”现会先创建完整备份，将 Profile 重置为默认模板插件并重新进入首次设置引导，同时在“快速恢复”页新增“撤销上次修复”支持一键还原；打开恢复助手时自动生成单文件故障报告，并采集本地崩溃转储与内存快照以便排查。
- **插件来源与 `Computer Use (Next)`:** “来源配置”新增 `dshfind` 插件索引一键填充与切换，“自定义插件市场”统一更名为“自定义插件索引”；桌面内置 Computer Use 插件更名为 `Computer Use (Next)`（命令仍为 `/computer-use`）。
- **Agents Anywhere 2.1.0:** 支持在网页端直接接力正在运行的 Codex 桌面会话，查看会话保持只读、仅在发言或操作时短暂接管，实现电脑与手机在同一会话轮流对话；会话顶部切换模型或权限立即生效，Agent 提问改为会话内异步表单；“设置 → 维护”新增“重装依赖环境”，支持切换 PyPI 镜像重建运行环境并自动从官方源补齐缺失包。

## 修复

- **macOS 重启权限保持:** 修复 macOS 下切换 Profile、恢复重启或插件变更重启后可能丢失系统“本地网络”权限的问题。
- **会话链接容错:** 对话中出现无法解析的 `dsh-session:` 文本时按普通文本保留，不再导致当前轮次对话报错中断。
- **Linux 打包与兼容:** 新增 Linux ARM64 打包校验；Linux AppImage 改用静态运行时，不再依赖系统安装 `libfuse.so.2`；修复 Next 打包时的社区市场依赖解析问题及上游 ACP 模式诊断输出混入 `stdout` 的问题。
- **Agents Anywhere 同步稳定性:** 修复接入已有 Codex 会话后历史消息乱序或交错的问题（升级后下次同步自动校准），消除搜索、图片查看与上下文压缩产生的重复记录，并修复多插件连接同一 Codex 时的交接超时与异常序号写入阻塞问题。

## 下载

从本页 **Assets** 下载对应平台的安装包：

| 平台 | 文件 |
| --- | --- |
| macOS Universal · Apple Silicon / Intel | `DSH-NEXT-2.0.21-next-universal.dmg` |
| Windows x64 | `DSH-NEXT-2.0.21-next-x64-Setup.exe` |
| Linux x64 · AppImage | `DSH-NEXT-2.0.21-next-x86_64.AppImage` |
| Linux x64 · Debian / Ubuntu | `DSH-NEXT-2.0.21-next-amd64.deb` |
| Linux x64 · tar.gz | `DSH-NEXT-2.0.21-next-linux-x64.tar.gz` |
| Linux ARM64 · AppImage | `DSH-NEXT-2.0.21-next-arm64.AppImage` |
| Linux ARM64 · Debian / Ubuntu | `DSH-NEXT-2.0.21-next-arm64.deb` |
| Linux ARM64 · tar.gz | `DSH-NEXT-2.0.21-next-linux-arm64.tar.gz` |

可使用本页 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 核验全部安装包。

## 使用提示

- 请先退出旧版应用并备份 `~/.dsh`（或在“设置 → 桌面设置”中使用“备份”），安装后验证常用插件和工作流程。
- 如需通过应用内终端管理 `desktop` Profile 的插件，请先启动 Desktop 完成该 Profile 的初始化。
- 从 2.0.17-next 或更早版本升级时，建议手动下载安装；旧版应用内更新可能无法完成下载。
- Office 文档技能首次使用时将随包运行时安装到 `~/.dsh/dsh-runtimes/dsh-next-primary-runtime`，需要额外磁盘空间。
- 默认与旧稳定版共用 `~/.dsh`；Profile 不隔离同一目录中的会话、账号和凭据。
- 可在“设置 → 桌面设置”或恢复助手中切换数据目录，也可通过绝对路径 `DSH_DESKTOP_NEXT_HOME` 隔离 DSH 数据（应用内选择优先于环境变量），但不会因此隔离 AA 的默认共享登录与设备绑定状态。

[完整变更记录](https://github.com/anywhere-labs/dsh-desktop/compare/v2.0.20-next...v2.0.21-next) · [项目网站](https://dshdesktop.cn)

DSH NEXT 已取代原稳定版通道。

---

# English

This Next release upgrades upstream to DeepSeek Harness v0.2.1-rc.4, improves launch speed and window state restoration, upgrades Profile repair, undo, and failure reporting in the recovery assistant, adds `dshfind` plugin index support, and upgrades the bundled Agents Anywhere plugin to 2.1.0 (adding Codex session handoff and dual-device turn-taking, dependency environment reinstallation, and history ordering fixes).

DSH NEXT is a community-maintained open-source project, not an official DeepSeek product.

**Upstream version:** [DeepSeek Harness v0.2.1-rc.4](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/releases/tag/dsh-v0.2.1-rc.4).

## New and improved

- **Startup speed and window experience:** Sped up macOS proxy detection when no system proxy is set and parallelized login-shell environment loading, enabled frontend script compilation caching for faster warm launches, and persisted the main window’s position, size, and maximized state across restarts.
- **Recovery assistant and Profile repair:** "Back up and repair current Profile" now creates a full backup before resetting the Profile to default template plugins and re-running first-launch onboarding, with a new "Undo last repair" action on Quick Recovery for one-click restoration. Opening the recovery assistant automatically generates a single-file failure report and captures local crash dumps and memory snapshots for troubleshooting.
- **Plugin sources and `Computer Use (Next)`:** Added one-click `dshfind` plugin index configuration and switching in Source Configuration, renamed "Custom plugin markets" to "Custom plugin indexes", and renamed the bundled desktop Computer Use plugin to `Computer Use (Next)` (keeping the `/computer-use` command).
- **Agents Anywhere 2.1.0:** Continue running Codex desktop sessions directly from the web while keeping viewing read-only and taking over briefly only when sending messages or performing actions so desktop and mobile can take turns in the same session; model and permission changes in the session header take effect immediately, and agent questions now use in-session async forms; added "Reinstall dependency environment" under **Settings → Maintenance** with PyPI mirror switching and automatic fallback to official PyPI for missing packages.

## Fixes

- **macOS permission preservation on restart:** Fixed in-app restarts (Profile switches, recovery restarts, and plugin changes) potentially losing macOS Local Network permissions.
- **Session link resilience:** Preserved undecodable `dsh-session:` text in conversations as plain text instead of failing the turn.
- **Linux packaging and compatibility:** Added Linux ARM64 packaging verification; switched Linux AppImage to a static runtime so `libfuse.so.2` is no longer required on the host system; fixed community market peer dependency resolution during Next packaging and upstream ACP diagnostics leaking into `stdout`.
- **Agents Anywhere sync stability:** Fixed out-of-order or interleaved history after attaching to an existing Codex session (automatically recalibrated on the next sync after upgrading), eliminated duplicate timeline entries from searches, image views, and context compaction, and fixed multi-plugin Codex handoff timeouts and oversized sequence number write stalls.

## Downloads

Choose the matching installer from **Assets** below:

| Platform | File |
| --- | --- |
| macOS Universal · Apple Silicon / Intel | `DSH-NEXT-2.0.21-next-universal.dmg` |
| Windows x64 | `DSH-NEXT-2.0.21-next-x64-Setup.exe` |
| Linux x64 · AppImage | `DSH-NEXT-2.0.21-next-x86_64.AppImage` |
| Linux x64 · Debian / Ubuntu | `DSH-NEXT-2.0.21-next-amd64.deb` |
| Linux x64 · tar.gz | `DSH-NEXT-2.0.21-next-linux-x64.tar.gz` |
| Linux ARM64 · AppImage | `DSH-NEXT-2.0.21-next-arm64.AppImage` |
| Linux ARM64 · Debian / Ubuntu | `DSH-NEXT-2.0.21-next-arm64.deb` |
| Linux ARM64 · tar.gz | `DSH-NEXT-2.0.21-next-linux-arm64.tar.gz` |

Use `SHA256SUMS.txt` from this release to verify all installers.

## Usage notes

- Quit the previous version and back up `~/.dsh` (or use **Back up** in **Settings → Desktop settings**) before installing. Verify your usual plugins and workflows afterward.
- Before managing plugins for the `desktop` Profile from the bundled terminal, launch Desktop to initialize that Profile.
- When upgrading from 2.0.17-next or earlier, download and install manually; in-app updates in those versions may not complete the download.
- The Office skills install the bundled runtime under `~/.dsh/dsh-runtimes/dsh-next-primary-runtime` on first use, requiring additional disk space.
- Defaults to the shared `~/.dsh` home. Profiles do not isolate sessions, accounts, or credentials within that home.
- Change the data directory in **Settings → Desktop settings** or the recovery assistant, or set `DSH_DESKTOP_NEXT_HOME` to an absolute path to isolate DSH data (an in-app choice takes precedence over the environment variable); this does not isolate AA’s default shared sign-in and device-binding state.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/anywhere-labs/dsh-desktop/compare/v2.0.20-next...v2.0.21-next) · [Project website](https://dshdesktop.cn)

DSH NEXT replaces the former Stable edition channel.

release.name: Codex++ v2.1.4
release.body:
本次为问题修复版：适配 Codex 26.1027，修复原生 Fast 按钮消失；修复网关在单供应商时因熔断 / 429 冷却比直连更容易失败；修复 Codex++ 以管理员身份运行时 Windows 商店版 Codex 启动后立即退出、主 Codex 用官方登录时 API 供应商多开仍走官方账号、插件市场搜不到插件等问题；供应商池可配置 new-api 访问令牌显示余额，DeepSeek 等厂商余额也显示在供应商卡片上。

### 新增

- **new-api 中转站显示余额**：识别为 new-api 的供应商，详情里多一行「访问令牌」，填上 new-api「个人设置 → 安全设置」里生成的访问令牌（新版分权限令牌需勾选「个人资料 · 查看」）后，卡片显示账户余额；不填时照旧（#2793）。
- **DeepSeek 等厂商的余额显示在供应商池卡片上**，与「用量」页同一来源（#2793）。
- **Agent 协作同一 Agent 可并发执行任务**：每个 Agent 可设「同时执行任务数」（1–4，默认 1，与之前一致）；未达上限时新任务直接开始，达到上限再排队，多个会话共用同一上限。并发任务请使用不同的工作目录，同一目录时会提示（#2800）。
- **多开页可直接编辑、删除供应商**：卡片悬停出现编辑和删除，删除前检查是否在用并二次确认；接入网关后「从第三方导入」（含 cc-switch）也不再被隐藏（#2801）。

### 修复

- Codex 26.1027 上原生 Fast 按钮消失：新版 Codex 改了入口模块的加载链路，Codex++ 找不到要改写的模块（#2788、#2792）。
- Windows：Codex++ 以管理员身份运行时，商店版 Codex 启动后会降权重启、脱离商店包环境而立即退出；现在以管理员运行时会让 Codex 跳过降权。Windows 激活 Codex 的调用加了超时，不再一直卡在「启动 Codex」（#2789、#2795、#2764）。
- 网关比直连更容易因限流失败：上游偶发几次 5xx 后，网关的熔断会把唯一的供应商整体挡 60 秒、全部本地回 429（`gateway_keys_cooling`），Codex 重试几次就报 exceeded retry limit。现在只有在有别家可换时才熔断；没给恢复时间的 429 首次只冷却 5 秒、并按上游给的恢复时间；Key 很快能恢复时网关稍等再发；「请求避震」不再对 429 反复重发同一个 Key（#2802、#2761）。
- 主 Codex 用官方登录时，用 API 供应商启动的多开实例仍以官方账号登录、消耗官方额度（#2794）。
- 经网关或本地代理转发到 Chat Completions / Anthropic 协议上游的流式请求，用量统计和请求日志里的 token 一直是 0（#2803）。
- 插件市场开启后，在 Codex 插件页搜索搜不到插件市场里的插件（新版 Codex 的插件搜索改走服务端）（#2790）。
- 侧栏折叠再展开时，已删除的会话会先闪出再消失（#2791）。
- 会话页的项目路径在 Windows 上显示 `//?/` 前缀，同一目录被分成两组（#2791）。
- 「修复与维护 → 同步目标」里出现点不了的内部别名 `codex_plus_managed`（#2791）。
- 旧版 Codex（例如 Intel Mac 上的 Codex）上用量状态栏不显示（#2753）。
- 从旧版本自动更新到新版本后，macOS「应用程序」文件夹里的 `.codex-plus-update-…` 残留目录没有被清理（#2774）。
- 供应商池卡片不再显示中转站类型（sub2api / new-api），只显示倍率和余额，类型放在悬停提示里。

release.name: v18.14.0
release.body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

### Breaking Changes

- Removed the Bun event-loop workaround utilities from `@oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core/utils/yield`; agent loops no longer insert cooperative sleeps while streaming or between tool calls.

### Added

- Added `AgentTool.approvalRestrictionPaths` so tools can report the paths they read, allowing restricted-folder approvals to cover those paths without remembering approval separately for each path.
- Added `Agent.logContext`, which adds custom context fields to every log record written during an agent run.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Breaking Changes

- Moved Anthropic header and endpoint helpers, along with Codex session/transport inspection and OpenAI Responses replay/storage helpers, to dedicated provider modules. Update imports from the previous locations.
- Updated auth-gateway model resolvers to receive `ModelResolveOptions`, including the route's native API wire and the scoped client's accepted grants. Scoped client IDs no longer fall back to scanning all models; resolvers now select the best permitted candidate.

### Added

- Added mTLS support for Anthropic connections through the `CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_CERT` and `CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_KEY` environment variables.

### Changed

- Provider implementations are now loaded on demand, reducing startup and memory overhead while preserving existing stream timeouts, cancellation, and host overrides.
- Account policy `priority` now takes precedence when usage information is temporarily unavailable, keeping new sessions on the preferred account.
- Improved provider-specific credential usage lookups so they no longer wait for unrelated providers, while preserving cache freshness, cancellation isolation, and complete aggregate reports. The corresponding server-side latency improvement requires an updated auth broker.
- Credential usage is now prefetched during session setup without selecting, pinning, or advancing the OAuth account rotation.

### Fixed

- Fixed Mistral thinking-message replay requests that could be rejected by LiteLLM with a `422 extra_forbidden` error.
- Fixed native Judge API requests missing the `omp/<version>` User-Agent, so omp usage is correctly identified in upstream statistics.
- Fixed Codex capacity-error retries over WebSocket and SSE ignoring provider-supplied `Retry-After` delays and retrying too early.
- Fixed cancelled OAuth refresh requests aborting the entire session, and ensured requests joining an existing refresh can still use the refreshed credential when the original request is cancelled.
- Fixed Cursor models losing omp system-prompt context, including context files, skills, and rules, on subsequent turns or when earlier messages precede the active turn.
- Fixed short-lived commands that refresh OAuth credentials, such as `omp token --force-refresh`, remaining open for several seconds after completing.
- Fixed TypeSafe authentication when `TYPESAFE_BASE_URL` is configured by validating keys against the correct `/v1/models` endpoint.
- Fixed forced tool calls on non-reasoning models causing an unhandled reasoning-effort error.
- Fixed interrupted turns reporting a transport error instead of the caller-provided cancellation reason.
- Fixed long-running pi-native turns being terminated before their first event by fetch or proxy timeouts by supporting keepalives and the configured first-event timeout.
- Fixed pi-native clients crashing when the auth gateway reports an upstream failure during streaming.
- Fixed Cursor turns failing after a mid-turn stream interruption when an automatic retry receives a zero-token provider error; retries now continue on the rotated conversation.
- Corrected auth-gateway debug logs so they no longer claim a retry occurred when a usage-limit error was returned without retrying.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Breaking Changes

- Removed the raw `@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog/models.json` export; use the bundled model registry APIs instead.

### Added

- Added `nextBuildPriceChange(cost, now)` to identify when a model's dated pricing card may change, allowing callers to safely reuse earlier builds until that time.
- Added the `selector-revision-suffix` catalog axis for Google Vertex, so `google-vertex/claude-opus-4-8` resolves exactly to `claude-opus-4-8@default`.

### Changed

- Reduced the bundled model catalog size and loading overhead.
- Updated role defaults so Factory Droid image models are preferred for the `image` role, allowing `generate_image` to work with only a Factory login.
- Updated `smol` and `slow` role defaults to use the currently bundled Cerebras and OpenAI Codex model identifiers.

### Fixed

- Fixed Mistral reasoning models so streamed thinking appears in the transcript and is preserved for subsequent turns.
- Fixed later-turn HTTP 422 errors in Mistral-hosted DeepSeek conversations when assistant reasoning history is included.
- Fixed DeepSeek V4.1 Flash image attachments being dropped for publisher-namespaced model IDs such as `ds/deepseek-flash`.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Breaking Changes

- Custom tool loaders now resolve the injected host SDK themselves; constructors take cwd as their first argument instead of a pi namespace.
- WebMCP now uses Chrome's native WebMCP support through WebMcpController, which accepts a Puppeteer Page. The former page-hook installation helpers, bridge constant, and page-hook types have been removed; Tern tabs no longer support WebMCP.
- Provider-qualified model selectors in --model, settings, roles, and task agents must identify an exact model ID or alias. Near matches now fail with a helpful error and suggestions instead of silently selecting a sibling model. Bare selectors such as opus retain fuzzy matching, and the Google Vertex Claude alias remains supported. Older migrated web fallback chains replace the retired Codex entry with openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol.

### Added

- Agents can send an interim response without ending the current task by writing Markdown to out:// (or using > out:// in bash), with streaming output up to 64 KiB. This is enabled by default in the interactive TUI and can be configured with out.enabled; it is disabled by default in print, RPC, and ACP sessions.
- Added computer-tool approval modes: tools.approval["computer.control"] can allow unattended foreground control on dedicated machines or deny the request without prompting. The approval mode does not itself grant access.
- Added optional task-file input (task.file=true), allowing subagent instructions to be loaded from an absolute UTF-8 file path or local:// URL with the submitted path and SHA-256 recorded ([#17133](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17133) by [@iliaal](https://github.com/iliaal)).
- Sessions can be pinned or unpinned from the resume picker with Alt+K and Alt+Shift+K, or the remappable app.session.pin and app.session.unpin actions. Pinned sessions move to the top and take priority in search results ([#9837](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/9837) by [@zhang17-24](https://github.com/zhang17-24)).
- Added PI_LINK_SCHEME and optional PI_LINK_HOST, allowing file links from SSH or tmux sessions to open through a desktop protocol handler ([#15855](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15855) by [@KunoLu](https://github.com/KunoLu)).
- Extensions and RPC clients can start live voice sessions using their own WebRTC peer, including phone-browser clients, through ctx.startLive({ sdpOffer }) or live_connect ([#17013](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17013) by [@materemias](https://github.com/materemias)).
- Extensions can customize assistant-text rendering and rerender individual replies through the opt-in extensionRenderers.assistantText setting ([#16238](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16238) by [@materemias](https://github.com/materemias)), and can register interactive link schemes with extension callbacks and renderer fallbacks ([#16239](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16239) by [@materemias](https://github.com/materemias)).
- /debug reports now include session-logs.txt containing all log records written by the reporting session and its subagents for the current day.
- Added prewalk.from and prewalk.into settings to choose the planning model and handoff target (default @default → @smol); /prewalk [into] and /prewalk restart [from] [into] override them for one command ([#17373](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17373) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC)).

### Changed

- Improved startup responsiveness by deferring nonessential UI, accessibility, browser, provider, slash-command, and interactive-composer loading until needed, and by overlapping independent session preparation work.
- OpenAI live steering is now disabled by default for GPT models. Typed messages wait for the next tool boundary unless providers.openaiLiveSteering is enabled, avoiding unsupported in-flight message errors.
- HTML exports now match the /stats visual design with a higher-contrast light theme, timeline and full-trace views, and navigation for nested subagents and advisors. Packaged viewers use integrity-pinned shared assets and require network access; source checkouts continue to embed the viewer.
- tui.autoGraph now defaults to auto: charts are refined by the judge for supported native TypeSafe judge models and otherwise use the built-in estimate.
- Filesystem changes are detected automatically, so manual scan-cache invalidation after edits is no longer needed.
- Model refreshes use substantially less CPU by reusing unchanged models and avoiding repeated model-cache database opens.
- Overlapping sloppy-edit operations are now applied sequentially, with each operation matched against the result of the preceding operation.
- PI_INTENT_PROMPT and PI_INTENT_DESC can now customize the system guidance and tool-schema description for the i intent field.
- Printed JSON values in eval, including large Python dictionaries and lists, are displayed as collapsible JSON trees.
- Codex and Claude rate-limit reset warnings now appear once per reset across conversations and windows, only during the final six hours; the status line continues to show the countdown.
- The . and c continue shortcuts now simply answer an unanswered last message instead of adding a hidden continue directive.
- With bash.gitGuard enabled, checkout, switch, restore, reset, and stash operations run safely in linked worktrees, while discarded uncommitted changes are preserved for recovery.
- Sessions with computer use enabled receive the desktop guide before the first computer call.
- The Tern interface now presents warnings, errors, update notices, file reads, and completed background work consistently with chat messages.
- Muted live voice sessions remain visibly muted while the voice model starts work.

### Fixed

- Fixed live configuration reloads missing edits immediately after a symlink switches to another file in the same directory.
- Fixed auth-gateway model routing after catalog refreshes so bare model IDs select the highest-priority credentialed provider, with wire-format compatibility used as a tie-breaker.
- Fixed chart recommendations that incorrectly inferred whether higher or lower values were better from row or column names; smart charting now uses the judge and avoids charting unsuitable numeric text such as page or step numbers.
- Fixed binary data flowing through background Bash pipelines being displayed as corrupted text or counted as huge line output.
- Fixed browser-tab closing delays when reattaching after a worker exits.
- Fixed startup warnings being obscured by the Tern interface; they now appear as normal in-app warnings.
- Fixed todo init clearing existing flat items when list was empty.
- Fixed legacy extensions using detached event handlers failing to load.
- Fixed MCP tools connected during vibe mode being activated prematurely and exceeding provider tool limits.
- Fixed Bash services rejecting port 0 when a log readiness condition was also provided.
- Fixed context usage and automatic compaction overstating token usage for inline tool descriptors.
- Fixed terminal titles not being restored after exit on terminals without title-stack support, including Windows consoles.
- Fixed cached approval directory grants that did not cover every target in a request.
- Fixed text typed during startup being delayed until startup completed, including resumed drafts.
- Fixed pull-request metadata and diffs remaining stale after a successful git push.
- Fixed live voice playback clicks when audio stalls mid-word.
- Fixed read rejecting artifact URLs from truncation hints under cached approvals or restricted folders.
- Fixed peer task acknowledgements being mistaken for final answers, so wait continues until the peer replies.
- Failed Hindsight memory recalls and retention operations now produce visible warnings instead of silently continuing without memory.
- Fixed long conflict-path handling, conflict-content selectors, and stale conflict IDs after aborted merges or external file changes.
- Fixed cancelled MCP OAuth flows and authentication lookups from crashing the session.
- Fixed progress HUD entries for idle local-model workers that were no longer used.
- Improved LSP diagnostics reliability across cold starts, push-diagnostics servers, save-only servers, retries, multi-server and multi-file edits, and reopened files; incomplete results are no longer reported as clean, and repeated clangd checks are faster.
- Fixed live job widgets showing incidental text from files, web pages, or search results instead of the actual job status.
- Fixed repeatedly failing advisor batches being retried indefinitely; they are now dropped after three failures.
- Fixed thinking overrides on prefix-bound Claude models from losing their provider prefix behavior during compaction and retries.
- Fixed failed large-value JSON queries from displaying the rejected value instead of a useful error.
- Fixed F5 retry reporting no retry when a background result arrived after cancellation or interruption.
- Fixed WebMCP invocation errors being empty and timed-out page invocations continuing to run.
- Fixed HTTP 413 errors for Factory Droid GPT and Grok after computer-use sessions by removing obsolete screenshots from requests.
- Fixed unavailable configured default or dictation models being silently replaced; omp now warns and identifies the fallback model.
- Fixed LSP references for files in sibling Git worktrees by adding those checkouts to the active workspace.
- Improved macOS computer-use behavior for applications without windows by opening the app and inspecting its returned window in one operation.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-natives

### Breaking Changes

- Removed the `invalidateFsScanCache` API and the associated filesystem scan cache environment variables (`FS_SCAN_CACHE_TTL_MS`, `FS_SCAN_EMPTY_RECHECK_MS`, `FS_SCAN_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES`, and `FS_SCAN_CACHE_MAX_BYTES`); filesystem listing caches are now managed automatically.

### Added

- Added a built-in `rsync` implementation to the bash tool, compatible with rsync 3.5.1 and protocol versions 29–33 across Linux, macOS, and Windows. It supports local copies, SSH remote shells via `-e`, and `rsync://` daemons without requiring an installed binary; daemon serving is not supported, and `PI_DISABLE_UUTILS_DESTRUCTIVE` continues to use the system `rsync`.
- Added built-in `ast-grep` (also available as `sg`) support to the bash tool for structural code search and rewriting, including pattern matching, rewrites, context, headings, and JSON output.

### Changed

- Improved native filesystem search performance, including faster globbing and more efficient grep, fuzzy finding, workspace listing, and structural search/edit operations, while preserving deterministic result ordering and streaming behavior.
- Native search and the bash tool's built-in `rg`, `grep`, `fd`, `find`, and `ast-grep` now stop filesystem work promptly when cancelled or timed out, including searches over JavaScript-provided filesystems and searches interrupted while reading large files.
- The bash tool's built-in `rg` and recursive `grep` now search files in parallel while retaining path-ordered output; `grep` can also stop promptly after reaching `maxCount`.
- Enabled safe reuse of unchanged directory listings when `cache: true`, with timestamp validation to prevent stale results.

### Fixed

- Fixed cancelled native directory searches leaving filesystem-provider requests running during startup.
- Fixed built-in bash commands such as `cat`, `grep`, `head`, `wc`, `read`, and `mapfile` hanging at the end of FIFO input on macOS; `read -t` now returns at EOF.
- Fixed ANSI text wrapping for styled underlines, background colours, and colon-form RGB colours.
- Fixed clicking in native audio playback when the queue runs dry mid-waveform by smoothly fading output to silence and back.

## @oh-my-pi/omp-stats

### Changed

- Improved `omp stats` session synchronization performance by approximately 2–5× on large histories. The first sync after upgrading may take up to a minute while the stats database is optimized.

### Fixed

- Fixed `/stats` and `omp stats` failing when another dashboard was syncing sessions or the configured port was already in use; busy dashboards are now reused, and a free port is selected when necessary.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Breaking Changes

- Moved `PINNED_HUD_TOGGLE_ID` to the coding agent's task output manager so reserving subagent IDs no longer loads the interactive editor.
- Updated `StatusLineHost.resetExpiryNotice` to receive the session and manage warning deduplication; custom status-line components must use the new signature.
- Removed `ToolExecutionHandle.setToolActivityVisible`; tool-activity visibility is now controlled by transcript components, while reply blocks remain visible by default.
- Removed the `@oh-my-pi/pi-tui/theme/defaults` export. Bundled palettes are now available through `getBuiltinThemes()` from `theme/defaults.json`.

### Fixed

- Fixed table-chart direction detection so measures are not incorrectly marked as better based on header words; single-measure tables are now sent for judging when local charting is appropriate.
- Fixed LSP diagnostics that incorrectly showed “No issues” before a language server had reported; such files are now shown as unverified. ([#17293](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17293) by [@JustasMasiulis](https://github.com/JustasMasiulis))
- Fixed Esc-Esc rewind in Tern selecting interrupted turns with no visible output instead of the last displayed turn.
- Fixed streamed code blocks losing lines that scrolled off screen before the closing fence arrived; completed lines now remain available in scrollback. ([#17333](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17333) by [@gzkGit777](https://github.com/gzkGit777))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-utils

### Added

- Added `logger.withContext(fields, fn)` to attach contextual fields to all records produced during a function and its asynchronous work, plus `logger.withoutContext(fn)` for work that should not inherit caller context.

### Fixed

- Fixed `untilAborted` so promises passed to an already-aborted signal are still observed, preventing later rejections from being reported as unhandled.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-wire

### Added

- Added the TSP `json` kind for displaying raw JSON values as interactive, expandable trees in the terminal.
- Added `TspEditorProps.typeahead` support so programs that cannot yet read input can preserve typed text, display it at the caret, and submit it when input becomes available.

release.name: Reasonix Studio v2.56.0
release.body:
本版新增项目栏「最近」跨项目找会话、每日定时深色模式和可关闭的输入框提示，并修复从旧版找回会话全部被跳过、更新失败后无法下载完整安装包等多处问题。

## 新增

- 项目栏新增「最近」：按最近活动时间跨项目列出会话，完整分页、可搜索；点选后定位到所属项目并打开会话，也可选择远程环境。关联 #14319 fixed in #14784 by @lancy69。
- 「外观 → 明暗」新增「定时」模式：每天按本机时间切换深色，默认 20:00 到次日 07:00，可跨午夜；桌面窗口的边框和底色同步变化。只有选择它时才生效。关联 #14699 fixed in #14783 by @lancy69。
- 「外观 → 会话显示」新增「输入框提示」开关：可隐藏输入框里的任务和排队占位文字，默认显示，只保存在本机。关联 #14759 fixed in #14781 by @lancy69。
- 文档：使用指南新增跨项目任务派发的完整流程。关联 #14603 fixed in #14780 by @lancy69。

## 变更

- 浏览器工具的说明现在提示模型读静态网页时用 web_fetch、用完关闭标签，避免一轮留下十几个页面。修复 #14737 fixed in #14764。
- 设置里「快捷键」页的卡片顺序调整：「Esc 停止任务」紧跟发送相关设置，全局快捷键和按键表放在后面。关联 #14789 fixed in #14790。

## 修复

- 从旧版找回会话时，目标文件夹里残留没有对话文件的过期索引，会让所有会话被反复跳过、一个都导入不了；现在会清掉它们并正常导入，侧栏里的未导入列表也能显示。修复 #14804 fixed in #14806。
- 更新失败后提示里的「下载完整安装包」改为用系统浏览器打开发布页，不再落到被设置页盖住的内置浏览器里。修复 #14775 fixed in #14788。
- 侧栏里「早先版本」和「恢复副本」那一行，悬停或键盘聚焦时重新显示删除按钮 ×。修复 #14703 fixed in #14803 by @xxoingr。
- 删除配置来源文件夹后，仍可移除残留的 MCP 服务；配置损坏时会保留服务，并指出无法解析的配置文件。关联 #14738 fixed in #14749 by @lancy69、#14739 fixed in #14749 by @lancy69。
- 连接远程主机（如 WSL）时，读取会话列表、删除、置顶或归档不再每次都重新建立连接；连接在最后一次操作后保留 45 秒。修复 #14745 fixed in #14763。
- 从对话分叉出的分支会继承源会话的上下文压缩简报，打开后继续在压缩视图上工作。关联 #14768 by @jf200s。
- 同一项目里并行启动的隔离任务不再偶尔因 Git 报 failed to read …/commondir 而失败。关联 #14805 by @xxoingr。
- 隔离结果应用、委派续跑和用量预算：应用时拒绝被换成目录链接的父目录，并发续跑不再重复创建转录副本，已知用量计入根预算，恢复任务时文件权限变化也会使旧证明失效。关联 #14025。

## 贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@lancy69、@xxoingr、@jf200s

---

<!-- lang:en -->

## New

- The project header gains "Recent": conversations across projects by last activity, paged and searchable; picking one locates its project and opens it, also on remote hosts. Refs #14319 fixed in #14784 by @lancy69.
- Appearance → Light and dark gains a "Scheduled" mode: dark during a daily local-clock range (default 20:00–07:00, overnight allowed); the window frame follows. Opt-in. Refs #14699 fixed in #14783 by @lancy69.
- Appearance → Conversation display gains a "Composer hint" switch that hides the task and queue placeholder text; on by default, remembered on this machine. Refs #14759 fixed in #14781 by @lancy69.
- Docs: the guide now walks through cross-project task dispatch. Refs #14603 fixed in #14780 by @lancy69.

## Changed

- The browser tool now tells the model to read static pages with web_fetch and to close tabs when done, so a turn no longer leaves a dozen pages open. Fixes #14737 fixed in #14764.
- On the Shortcuts settings page, "Esc to stop" now sits right after the send settings, with the global shortcut and the key table after it. Refs #14789 fixed in #14790.

## Fixed

- Recovering older sessions no longer skips every conversation because of stale indexes with no transcript in the destination; they are cleared and the import proceeds. Fixes #14804 fixed in #14806.
- After a failed update, "download the full installer" opens the release page in the system browser instead of the in-app browser behind the settings sheet. Fixes #14775 fixed in #14788.
- An earlier version or recovery copy in the sidebar shows its delete × again on hover or keyboard focus. Fixes #14703 fixed in #14803 by @xxoingr.
- Stale MCP servers can be removed after their source folder is deleted; a malformed config names the file and keeps the servers. Refs #14738 fixed in #14749 by @lancy69, #14739 fixed in #14749 by @lancy69.
- On a remote host such as WSL, listing, deleting, pinning or archiving sessions no longer reconnects every time; the link is held 45 seconds after the last action. Fixes #14745 fixed in #14763.
- A fork inherits its source's compacted context, so the branch continues on the compacted view. Refs #14768 by @jf200s.
- Isolated tasks started in parallel in one project no longer fail now and then with Git's "failed to read …/commondir". Refs #14805 by @xxoingr.
- Isolated results and delegation: applying refuses a parent directory swapped for a link, parallel continuations no longer duplicate copies, and known usage counts toward budgets. Refs #14025.

## Contributors

Thanks to this release's contributors: @lancy69, @xxoingr, @jf200s

## What's Changed
* fix(delegation): reserve ancestor copy admission / 预留祖先副本续跑准入 by @SivanCola in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14684
* fix(agent): count reported totals in token budgets / 将已报告总量计入 token 预算 by @SivanCola in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14730
* feat(e2ebench): a batch emits an auditable manifest by @chuiwenwei in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14757
* fix(agent): invalidate carried proof after file-mode changes / 文件模式变化时拒绝旧证明 by @SivanCola in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14677
* feat(studio): show green unread markers instead of session dates by @lancy69 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14746
* feat(studio): optional progress track for collapsed plans by @lancy69 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14747
* fix(serve): hold a request's remote link past its answer by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14763
* fix(tools): tell the model browser_open is visible and web_fetch reads static pages by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14764
* feat(studio): choose steer or follow-up as the running-message default by @lancy69 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14750
* fix(control): remove stale MCP entries without losing source authority by @lancy69 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14749
* fix(control): a fork inherits its source's context projection by @jf200s in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14768
* feat(control): support precise @path:start-end file references by @lancy69 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14748
* fix(worktree): guard apply ancestors and confine deletions / 防止父目录链接重定向隔离结果删除 by @SivanCola in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14726
* test(stats): every aggregate field declares its provenance by @chuiwenwei in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14769
* fix(control): bound the fallback recovery task summary by runes by @kevin9327 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14773
* fix(worktree): cut git stderr in error messages on a rune boundary by @kevin9327 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14774
* docs: explain cross-project task dispatch by @lancy69 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14780
* fix(studio): the full-installer link after a failed update opens the system browser by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14788
* fix(studio): Esc-to-stop sits with the send settings on the Shortcuts page by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14790
* test(desktop): the settings search is measured without the storage tally by @1012905 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14791
* feat(serve): 通过 POST /tree/sessions/remove-many 批量删除会话 by @1012905 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14771
* feat(studio): add a default-on composer hint visibility setting by @lancy69 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14781
* ci(android): build the APK on a tag and attach it to the release by @imcreazy in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14493
* feat(studio): add a daily dark-mode schedule by @lancy69 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14783
* fix(studio): an earlier version in the sidebar shows its delete button by @xxoingr in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14803
* fix(sessionstore): stale indexes with no transcript no longer make every 1.x import copy_failed by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14806
* fix(worktree): run one repository's worktree commands one at a time by @xxoingr in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14805
* fix(studio): share pane startup workspace metadata by @lancy69 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14800
* fix(agent): preserve unknown scope across yielded workspace claims by @lancy69 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14801
* feat(studio): add globally paged recent session discovery by @lancy69 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14784
* docs(parity): scheduled runs exist in Studio; the 1.x heartbeat loop is the gap by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14808
* docs(release-notes): studio 2.56.0 by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14810


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/compare/studio-v2.55.0...studio-v2.56.0


---

**macOS** 已用 Developer ID 签名并公证，打开时不需要清除隔离属性。**Windows** 的窗口、内核与安装器都经 Certum 代码签名证书做了 Authenticode 签名。**Linux** Debian 系从 `.deb` 安装，Fedora、RHEL、openSUSE 等从 `.rpm` 安装（`sudo dnf install ./ReasonixStudio-linux-amd64.rpm`）。x86_64 用文件名带 amd64 的包，aarch64（统信 UOS、麒麟等）用带 arm64 的包。也提供 `.AppImage`（只提供下载，不会自更新；需要 FUSE 2，或用 `--appimage-extract-and-run` 启动）。

三个平台都能自更新：Linux 的 `.deb` 走自己的包（`.rpm` 的自更新尚未提供，请手动下载新包），Windows 运行下一个安装器，macOS 替换自身 bundle。

release.name: CC Switch v4.0.22
release.body:
# CC Switch v4.0.22

本版本新增对 DeepSeek Harness 的支持，它是 CC Switch 管理的第 14 个应用：供应商一起写进它的 Web 和 Desktop 配置，MCP、Skills、提示词同步给它，会话可以浏览，「应用」页可以安装、升级、卸载；还可以在授权中心登录 DeepSeek 账号、查看余额，用量也会统计。Oh My Pi 的用量现在也会统计。「打开终端」可以勾选跳过权限确认、追加启动参数，Codex 卡片也能打开终端；WebDAV 配置可以清除；Skills 可以打开目录、在发现页查看文档；GitHub Copilot 的 Claude 模型改走原生接口，提示缓存命中率大幅提高。另外修复了 macOS 上连了 OAuth 远程 MCP 时切换 Claude 账号失败、开了全局代理时添加 Claude 账号报 403、Claude Desktop 新会话默认用 Fable、MiniMax 周额度用完后不显示、没在用的供应商余额不自动刷新、请求被转回路由自己导致内存暴涨、Gemini 工具调用报 400、xAI 拒绝 Codex 0.163 的请求、请求日志里存下整页报错把数据库撑大等问题。4.0 完整的更新内容请见 [v4.0 发布说明](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.4-zh.md)。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.22-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.22-ja.md)**

---

## 新增

### DeepSeek Harness

DeepSeek Harness（命令是 `dsh`）现在是一个独立的应用，有自己的供应商、MCP、Skills、提示词和会话（[#8795](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8795)、[#8986](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8986)）。配置在 `~/.dsh`，设了 `DSH_HOME` 时以它为准。

- **Web 和 Desktop 一起管理。** DeepSeek Harness 的网页版和桌面版各有一份配置（profile），CC Switch 把供应商和 MCP 同时写进两份，缺的那份会自动建好；已经初始化的 headless、acp 也一起写。侧栏只有一个 DeepSeek Harness，「已添加」标题旁注明 Web 和 Desktop 共用这份列表。某一份被手动改得和另一份不一样时，编辑会被拒绝并提示，不会覆盖你的改动。
- **供应商可以同时添加。** 和 OpenCode 一样是「添加」「移除」，多个供应商同时写进去，在 DeepSeek Harness 里选模型。支持 OpenAI Chat Completions、OpenAI Responses、Anthropic Messages 三种接口，预设来自 Pi 的目录。API Key 写进 DeepSeek Harness 自己的凭据文件 `.credentials.yaml`，配置里只放引用；配置里的其他插件设置原样保留，写入失败会回滚。
- **模型编辑。** 思考、图片输入用开关，上下文长度和最大输出单独填，和 Pi、Kimi Code 的模型行一样；DeepSeek Harness 还可以设置可选的思考档位和每个模型的接口兼容选项。OpenCode、MiniMax Code 的模型编辑也改成了这个样子。
- **DeepSeek 账号登录。** 在授权中心的 DeepSeek Harness 组用浏览器登录 DeepSeek 账号，显示余额和赠金；Web 和 Desktop 共用这份登录，在任一处登录或退出，两边同时生效。添加供应商时选「DeepSeek 官方登录」会跳到授权中心。登录后，账号以一张官方卡显示在「已添加」最前面，账号下的模型由 DeepSeek Harness 自己提供，这张卡不能编辑，退出登录后自动消失。
- **MCP、Skills、提示词。** 支持 stdio 和 Streamable HTTP 两种 MCP。
- **会话和用量。** 可以浏览 DeepSeek Harness 的会话（含思考过程和工具调用）；恢复和删除会话请在 DeepSeek Harness 里操作。用量从会话记录导入，走 DeepSeek 账号的请求在用量页单独显示为「DeepSeek 账号（OAuth）」。
- **「应用」页管理 DeepSeek Harness。** 用 npm 安装、升级、卸载 `@deepseek-ai/dsh`，卸载不删你的数据。
- DeepSeek Harness 不经过本地路由。

### Oh My Pi 的用量统计

用量页现在会统计 Oh My Pi 的用量，有自己的应用分类（[#9046](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9046)、[#8939](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8939)）。子代理的用量、对话之外的模型调用也会算进去，首次导入会包括以前的子代理会话。Oh My Pi 和 Pi 用同一个会话目录时，各自只导入自己的会话。Pi 已导入的数据不用重新导入。

### 「打开终端」可以跳过权限确认、追加启动参数

「打开终端」对话框多了两项（[#9008](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9008)）：

- **跳过权限确认。** 勾选后 Claude Code 和 Antigravity 以 `--dangerously-skip-permissions` 启动，Codex 以 `--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox` 启动。默认不勾。
- **附加参数（可选）。** 填 `--debug`、`--append-system-prompt "Be concise"` 这类参数，接在启动命令后面。用空格分隔，含空格的值用引号括起来，最多 16 个。参数只作为参数传给程序，不会被当成命令执行。

两项都只用于这次打开的终端，不写进任何配置；终端打开成功后，CC Switch 会按应用记住你的选择。

### Codex 卡片也能「打开终端」

以前 Codex 卡片上没有这个按钮。现在第三方卡片打开的终端只用这张卡：以 `codex -c ...` 启动，不改 `config.toml`，Key 通过环境变量传入，不出现在命令行里。当前供应商在 `config.toml` 里留下的设置会尽量改成不影响这张卡的值，改不了的（比如请求头、指定的 profile）会提示先切到这张卡再打开，避免当前供应商的 Key 被发到别处。当前使用中的卡直接启动 `codex`。

### 清除 WebDAV 配置

以前配好 WebDAV 同步后，只能关掉自动同步，地址、账号、密码一直留在本机（[#8977](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8977)）。现在 WebDAV 同步设置里有「清除配置」按钮，确认后从本机删除这些信息并停止自动同步；云端已上传的数据不会删除。

### Skills：打开目录、复制名称、查看文档

- **已安装的 Skill**（[#8993](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8993)）：⋯ 菜单里可以「打开目录」，在文件管理器里打开这个 Skill 的文件夹；点击 Skill 名称就能复制名称。原来的「复制目录名」去掉了。
- **发现页**（[#9039](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9039)）：每一行多了「打开文档」按钮，安装前可以先看说明，没有文档时打开仓库主页。

## 改进

**GitHub Copilot 的 Claude 模型提示缓存命中率大幅提高**（[#8908](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8908)）。以前 Copilot 的 Claude 模型一律转成 Chat Completions 格式发送，会丢掉缓存标记，Claude Code 在对话中途插入的系统消息还会打断缓存。现在 Copilot 支持原生 Anthropic 接口的模型直接走原生接口，Copilot 企业版长会话的缓存命中率实测从约 35% 提高到约 95%。

**添加、启用、停用、删除 Skill 仓库时，只重新读取这一个仓库**（[#8907](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8907)、[#1426](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/1426)），不再把所有仓库重新下载一遍。点刷新按钮仍会全部重新读取。

**托盘和用量设置里也能看到绑了账号的 Claude 官方卡额度。** 以前只有卡片上显示，托盘里没有，用量设置弹窗还显示成未启用。

**Claude Desktop 的路由服务也接受 `x-api-key` 传令牌**（[#5123](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/5123)），令牌校验改成固定耗时的比较（[#7488](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/7488)、[#7482](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7482)）。

**Claude 配置目录在 WSL 里时，授权中心直接说明暂不支持 Claude 账号**，「添加账号」「重新登录」不可用。以前会让你改用「打开终端」，但这时打开的是 Windows 里的 Claude Code，同样用不了。

**MCP、Skills 列表悬停勾选框时不再同时弹出两个提示**；问号帮助卡片改为显示在右边，不再挡住鼠标，长内容会换行、在卡片里滚动（[#8593](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8593)）。

**从别处跳到授权中心的某一组时，页面其他部分不再跟着移动**（[#8964](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8964)）。

**OpenCode、OpenClaw、Hermes 的配置文件读不了时，供应商页会显示错误**（[#9044](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9044)）。以前页面像从没配置过一样空着，添加供应商失败后才看到报错，还会留下一条多余的记录。

**托管的 ChatGPT、xAI 账号登录过期时，提示改为「请在授权中心重新登录这个账号」。** 以前提示运行一条并不存在的命令。

**预设：** 新增 OspreyAI、讯飞星火 Astron Coding Plan 的 Claude Code 预设（[#9036](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9036)）；TokenFlux 改用新域名 tokenflux.com，tokenflux.dev 作为备用地址。

## 修复

- **macOS 上连了需要 OAuth 登录的远程 MCP 时，切换 Claude 账号报「Claude Code 的登录信息太大，无法写入钥匙串，没有切换」**（[#9002](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9002)）。MCP 的登录信息和账号存在同一个钥匙串条目里，超过了一次写入的长度上限。现在超长时改用和 Claude Code 一样的写法。
- **开了全局代理时，在授权中心添加 Claude 账号，浏览器登录成功后报 403**（[#9038](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9038)）。换取令牌是 Claude Code 自己完成的，以前它没有用到全局代理。现在 CC Switch 运行 Claude Code 登录、查额度时会把全局代理传给它（SOCKS 代理 Claude Code 不支持，不传）。
- **Claude Desktop 新会话默认用 Fable，而且模型顺序每次启用配置都会变**（[#7491](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/7491)、[#7457](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7457)、[#8973](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8973)）。Claude Desktop 把模型列表里的第一个当默认模型，以前按字母顺序写。现在按界面上 Sonnet、Opus、Fable、Haiku 的顺序写，新会话默认用 Sonnet 档。
- **MiniMax 周额度用完后，卡片和托盘里不再显示周额度，5 小时额度刚重置时看起来像额度全满**（[#8124](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8124)、[#8123](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8123)）。现在显示为红色的「已用完」和周额度重置倒计时。
- **没在用的供应商设了自动查询间隔，余额也不刷新**（[#8342](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8342)、[#8335](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8335)）。
- **上游地址填成了路由自己的地址时，请求被无限转回路由，内存不断增长**（[#8598](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8598)）。现在直接报配置错误。
- **Claude Code 经路由连 Gemini 时，工具调用后报 400**：签名放错位置报「Unknown name thoughtSignature」（[#6690](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/6690)）；CC Switch 重启后或较早的轮次丢了签名，Gemini 3 以上拒绝请求（[#6833](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/6833)）；Vertex 上工具结果后面跟着文字时报「Requests ending with a model turn are not supported」（[#8988](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8988)）。
- **Claude Code 经路由转 OpenAI Responses 时，WebSearch 带屏蔽域名就直接报 400**（[#8979](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8979)）。现在 API Key 接入的 Responses 上游会原样传过去；ChatGPT 官方登录的路由不支持屏蔽域名，仍会明确报错。
- **Codex 0.163 以上经路由连 xAI 时报 400**（[#8997](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8997)、[#8996](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8996)）。
- **Codex 的 `config.toml` 里有 `[[skills.config]]` 这类数组表时，第三方供应商的地址被写进了这张表里**（[#9029](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9029)、[#9023](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9023)）。
- **OpenCode 新格式（V2）的供应商「检测连通」报缺少 `options.baseURL`**（[#8969](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8969)）。
- **上游报错时，请求日志存下整页 HTML 报错，数据库和备份越来越大**（[#9010](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9010)、[#6706](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/6706)）。现在每条只存前 4096 个字符；已经存下的旧记录这次不清理。
- **Windows 上用 MyDockFinder 这类第三方任务栏时，点托盘图标没反应**（[#8729](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8729)、[#8565](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8565)）。
- **Kimi Code 0.43.0 以前的版本在「应用」页升级后版本不变**（[#9032](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9032)）。旧版本没有自动确认升级的选项，现在改用安装它的包管理器，或重新运行官方安装脚本。
- **「应用」页里，程序文件在但运行不起来的应用，分在「已安装」组里却显示「未安装」。** 现在显示为「无法运行」，并给出原因。
- **Antigravity 的 CLI 和 IDE 都装了时，在 IDE 里继续的旧会话用量不更新、会话打不开**（[#8941](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8941)）。

## 升级说明

**数据库版本从 23 升到 24**，为 MCP 和 Skills 增加 DeepSeek Harness 的开关。升级前会自动备份数据库；升级后再退回旧版本，旧版本会提示数据库版本过新，打不开。

- DeepSeek Harness 默认显示在侧栏，不用的话可以在「应用」页关掉「在侧栏显示 DeepSeek Harness」。

---

## 致谢

感谢 @funkpopo、@yang227、@Byzhazha、@YUZHEthefool（DeepSeek Harness 支持、账号登录与用量统计）、@shimenga、@allenxu09（Oh My Pi 用量统计；allenxu09 还做了第三方任务栏的托盘点击、Skill 仓库按需读取）、@linghaoSu（Copilot 原生接口）、@hekuanga（Gemini 签名位置）、@SailingLoong（Claude Desktop 模型顺序）、@John1Tang、@yukitakasama（Claude Desktop 令牌校验）、@cenglin123（MiniMax 周额度）、@deefery（xAI 请求）、@szupzj18（Codex 数组表）、@zayokami（请求日志报错截断）的贡献。funkpopo 还做了 Skills 打开目录、余额自动刷新、帮助提示、路由自环检测和授权中心跳转。

感谢 @MTpupil、@router0mail、@AceGain、@foxbye、@xzxiaoshan、@CYRickyArAr、@Justinckkk、@bzqCoding、@failedman-1、@leoXu-612、@xyzper、@TeaDrink666、@hedandan1989、@xthomaswang、@yeuxuan、@JasonDing1024、@didahapy-ux、@lbigdate、@reboom、@sojo-negai、@muchenkezhan 报告问题、提供复现信息和修复思路。

特别感谢以下贡献者：你们的 PR 发现并修复了真实的问题，只是同样的问题后来在主线上另行修好，PR 因此关闭。@HP-network、@jzcangshu、@HadesScience、@cc-claws。

完整的技术细节请见 [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)。

release.body:
## What's Changed
* feat: add threshold-based model selection (default 0.7) by @xuanaozhang1-coder in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/2884
* feat(router): align token-aware context compression by @xuanaozhang1-coder in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/2945
* fix: improve DeepSeek Harness history imports by @kev1n77 in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3501
* docs: refresh README media and community links by @GCWing in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3510
* revert(web-ui): remove the navigation bar October 24 accent by @bobleer in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3511
* fix(web-ui): remember the session right pane open state per session by @kev1n77 in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3506
* fix(process,hooks): restore login-shell PATH on linux and stop timed-out hook process groups by @kev1n77 in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3512
* fix(desktop): restore pet navigation with embedded browser views by @bobleer in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3513
* fix(remote-ssh): strip WSL host diagnostics from streamed stderr by @kev1n77 in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3514
* fix(remote-ssh): stop reporting a delivered kill as a missing process by @kev1n77 in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3515
* fix(desktop): isolate development hosts and polish subscription settings by @GCWing in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3520
* fix(web): prevent Prism worker handler conflict by @kev1n77 in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3521
* fix(chat): show TTFT separately and exclude first-token waits from TPS by @bobleer in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3522
* fix(ai): request stream usage with compatibility fallback by @bobleer in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3523
* fix(web): break TabBar ResizeObserver feedback loop by @kev1n77 in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3524
* fix(browser): isolate embedded pages by conversation by @bobleer in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3526
* fix(hooks,exec-command): hand the login-shell PATH to hooks and shell commands by @kev1n77 in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3525
* fix(web): prevent stale workspace requests during peer surface hydration by @kev1n77 in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3528
* docs: flatten the README wordmark onto white by @bobleer in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3529
* fix(web): move provider deletion into the editor footer by @bobleer in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3531
* fix(ui): reveal capsule actions without covering labels or shifting rows by @bobleer in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3534
* fix(ui): keep tab titles clear of stationary close actions by @bobleer in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3535
* feat(creative): add Hypit to on-demand video skills by @bobleer in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3536
* fix(ui): remove Git panel entry points and shortcuts by @guantw in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3538
* fix(ui): resolve 13 native desktop usability audit findings by @bobleer in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3539
* fix(ui): polish usage calendar workspace and chat presentation by @bobleer in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3540
* feat(desktop-cards): add chart templates and React compatibility fixes by @bobleer in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3541
* feat(web): refine project and subscription flows and add MiniApp demos by @GCWing in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3543
* feat(tools): Add programmatic tool calling by @wsp1911 in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3546
* fix(ai): Preserve conversations across model switches by @wsp1911 in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3547
* fix(ai): default OpenBitFun and Kimi Coding presets to OpenAI by @bobleer in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3548
* feat(miniapp): support image prompts from Hi chat by @bobleer in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3550
* fix(web-ui): preserve welcome scene rounded corner background by @kev1n77 in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3551
* fix(chat): Preserve modes across session switches by @wsp1911 in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3552
* fix(auth): allow two email codes per address per minute by @bobleer in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3553
* fix(mobile-web): prioritize devices and assistant workspaces by @bobleer in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3556
* fix(plan): Fix build lifecycle and language by @wsp1911 in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3555
* fix(mobile-web): normalize assistant modes before queue submission by @bobleer in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3557
* fix(mobile-web): show outline assistant icons in workspace list by @bobleer in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3558
* feat(images): add subscription image generation and compact previews by @kev1n77 in https://github.com/GCWing/OpenBitFun/pull/3554

release.name: Paseo v0.14.0
release.body:
## 0.14.0 - 2026-10-29

Plugins can now add tools to individual agents and configure their MCP servers when sessions open.

Completed conversation turns can be collapsed into summaries and expanded to read the full exchange.

Voice settings now let you configure speech providers and download local models with one tap, including SenseVoice and Whisper for Chinese dictation. Voice mode is now opt-in.

### Added

- Let plugins give tools to specific agents ([#7938](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7938))
- Added Chat display settings that group tool calls or collapse completed conversation turns ([#7785](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7785), [#7990](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7990), [#8026](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/8026), [#8042](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/8042), [#8109](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/8109) by @akaready, @Dey11, @Sebeb, @Waishnav)
- Let plugins add MCP servers whenever an agent session opens ([#7983](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7983))
- Added downloadable local speech models in Voice settings, including SenseVoice and Whisper for Chinese dictation ([#7295](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7295))
- Added a choice of Enter or ⌘/Ctrl+Enter to send messages ([#5503](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/5503) by @lukelabonte)
- Added sent-message recall with Up and Down in an empty web or desktop Composer ([#7710](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7710))
- Added long-press Send to queue a message or send it immediately ([#7897](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7897) by @bjspi)
- Added project-specific editor choices, including Xcode on macOS ([#7898](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7898) by @kinoroy)

### Improved

- Release eligible agent runtimes after one idle hour, resuming the saved session on the next prompt ([#7782](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7782))
- Added a link back to the parent in subagent panes ([#7784](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7784))
- Opened subagents in place of the subagent list on phones, with Back returning to the list ([#8093](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/8093))
- Added clickable links and selectable descriptions to question cards ([#7419](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7419) by @NoSync)
- Kept large Import session lists responsive on web ([#7872](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7872) by @royenheart)
- Enlarged project and workspace menu buttons on phones ([#7928](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7928))
- Stopped hidden chats from rendering incoming text updates ([#7901](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7901))
- Reduced stalls when highlighting and wrapping large diffs ([#8006](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/8006), [#7945](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7945))
- Reduced daemon stalls when opening and paging large Claude and OMP histories ([#7789](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7789), [#7940](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7940), [#7948](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7948), [#7958](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7958) by @ragokan)
- Reduced daemon stalls during plugin builds, image processing and config reloads ([#7967](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7967), [#7954](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7954), [#7959](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7959))
- Reduced blocking filesystem work during workspace and project refreshes ([#7941](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7941), [#7943](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7943), [#7944](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7944))

### Fixed

- Fixed terminal glyph corruption when shared WebGL texture atlases change ([#8013](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/8013) by @donghyeonan)
- Fixed restored workspaces with no open chat staying on Loading workspace at launch on phones ([#7918](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7918))
- Fixed restored agent tabs appearing in unrelated workspaces ([#7956](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7956) by @odoo-mvds)
- Fixed background Git fetches opening credential prompts ([#8019](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/8019))
- Fixed failed SSH tunnels crashing callers with an unhandled EPIPE ([#7876](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7876))
- Fixed brief Windows file locks preventing atomic saves ([#7955](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7955))
- Fixed large ACP terminal output blocking daemon requests ([#7953](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7953) by @bbtfr)
- Fixed messages sent during Pi manual compaction failing instead of waiting ([#7848](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7848) by @itssimon)
- Fixed late tool updates creating duplicate rows during overlapping turns ([#8010](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/8010) by @luoph)
- Fixed plugin ACP reasoning appearing inside assistant replies when message IDs match ([#7272](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7272) by @cncolder)
- Fixed outside-folder links replacing Files with an access error ([#7726](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7726) by @jtomaszewski)
- Fixed command suggestions overlapping a growing Composer on phones ([#7910](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7910))
- Fixed bare Markdown URLs losing ports or stopping at colons in paths ([#7859](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7859) by @mariotaku)
- Fixed inline code sizing inside emphasis, links and headings ([#7889](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7889), [#8088](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/8088))
- Fixed compact navigation sizes and a cramped Settings detail pane in docked windows 600–719 wide ([#8052](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/8052) by @zeyugao)
- Fixed Settings losing the selected host or sidebar scroll position between sections ([#7893](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7893), [#7899](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7899) by @bingqilinweimaotai, @wangnan0916)
- Fixed OpenCode v2 subagent rows missing model and token details ([#7799](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7799) by @Davnn1)
- Fixed file-link tooltips staying over the preview after leaving a chat ([#7842](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7842))
- Fixed model discovery errors touching the model picker edges ([#8039](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/8039) by @ilteoood)
- Fixed model selectors staying open over Settings ([#7783](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7783) by @ragokan)

### Notes

- Voice mode now defaults to off; enable it in Voice settings
- If environment variables select OpenAI speech, move keys and endpoints stored only in legacy `providers.openai` into Voice settings
- Before downgrading to 0.13.2, restore a backed-up `config.json` or convert speech credentials and idle-cleanup settings saved by 0.14.0
- Install the optional [Claude Code entrypoint plugin](https://paseo.sh/plugins/getpaseo/claude-code-entrypoint-env) to launch Claude sessions with `CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT=Paseo`, a community workaround for subscription limits draining faster ([#7976](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/7976), [#8164](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo/pull/8164) by @david828019-oss)

* fix(videoview): resilient swapchain creation and WARP fallback by @huynhsontung in https://github.com/huynhsontung/Screenbox/pull/1114

### User Experience

* style: improve player page with shortcuts and updated icons by @United600 in https://github.com/huynhsontung/Screenbox/pull/1136

repository.description: Jan is an open source alternative to ChatGPT that runs 100% offline on your computer.
repository.name: jan

release.body:
## Jan v0.8.8: security fixes, llama.cpp 0.7.0, and Trusted Hosts for the local API

A security update to v0.8.7. We recommend updating. Your data and settings carry over; a few behaviours change, listed under **What you might notice**.

### Security

- **Links in chat open in your browser.** Links in model replies, tool results, model cards and release notes now always open in your system browser, never inside Jan's window. Links that aren't web or email links are shown as plain text.
- **The local API server checks where browser requests come from.** A web page can only call it if its origin is trusted: the same machine, Jan itself, or a host you list in **Trusted Hosts**. Requests without a browser origin (SDKs, scripts, curl, Claude Code) work as before.
- **Server-side tool execution stays opt-in for every endpoint.** Requests to the local API run MCP tools only when **Settings > Local API Server** allows server-side tool execution.
- **Paths are checked before Jan reads or writes them.** Thread and assistant ids, and the file operations extensions use, stay inside Jan's data folder.
- **The Claude Code integration writes your shell profile safely.** Values are quoted, unusual variable names are refused, and Jan's lines are kept in one marked block that Reset removes completely without touching your own lines.
- **The agent's file tools no longer follow a link out of their workspace**, and folders such as your home, credentials and startup folders can't be attached as writable.
- **Windows: Jan runs system tools from the Windows system folder**, and sign-in links are opened without going through `cmd`.
- **MCP sign-in only uses web addresses** (`http`/`https`) for its endpoints.

### What you might notice

- **Trusted Hosts for browser-based clients.** A web app on another machine (for example Open WebUI's direct connection) or a browser extension calling Jan's API needs its host added to **Settings > Local API Server > Trusted Hosts**. Entries can include a scheme, so `app://obsidian.md` works for Obsidian plugins (thanks to [@SnowingFox](https://github.com/SnowingFox), [#8608](https://github.com/janhq/jan/issues/8608)). Pages without a normal origin (local files, sandboxed frames) can be allowed by listing `file://` or `null`.
- **The CORS switch now takes effect**, and it starts **on** after updating. In earlier versions it was shown but had no effect.
- **Custom environment variables for Claude Code:** keys that change how programs are found (`PATH`, `PATHEXT`, `SystemRoot`, `ComSpec`, `LD_*`, `DYLD_*`, `JAN_*` and the GPU runtime paths Jan uses) are refused with a message. Other variables, including `NODE_OPTIONS`, save as before.
- **Moving the data folder** to a system folder, your home folder itself or a drive root (for example `D:\`) is refused; choose a folder such as `D:\Jan`.
- **MCP servers whose sign-in endpoints aren't web addresses** now show a sign-in error.

### New

**llama.cpp engine 0.7.0.**

The bundled engine moves from 0.5.0 to 0.7.0 (b11669). New per-model settings: an **MoE expert GPU cache** for mixture-of-experts models, **Probabilistic draft sampling** and **Draft batch size** for speculative decoding. They default to the engine's own defaults, so nothing changes unless you set them. Saved prompt caches from the previous engine are discarded once and rebuilt. ([#9399](https://github.com/janhq/jan/pull/9399))

### Fixes

**Local models failed to load on Windows when the user name had non-English characters** (for example Cyrillic). ([#9418](https://github.com/janhq/jan/pull/9418))

**With an HTTP proxy configured, documents with "Use embeddings" failed**, because Jan's requests to its own engine went through the proxy. They now go direct; remote providers still use the proxy. ([#9353](https://github.com/janhq/jan/pull/9353))

**An attachment was sent again on every turn**, adding a copy per message and defeating the prompt cache. It's now included once per request. Thanks to [@yaodong-shen](https://github.com/yaodong-shen). ([#9358](https://github.com/janhq/jan/pull/9358))

**With Shell turned off, a model that called the shell ended its reply.** It now gets "Shell is turned off" and the reply continues. ([#9319](https://github.com/janhq/jan/issues/9319))

**macOS: quitting Jan left the MLX server running** with its model in memory. It's stopped on quit, and one left by an earlier Jan is stopped at startup; an MLX server you started yourself is left alone. ([#9355](https://github.com/janhq/jan/pull/9355))

### Thanks

Fixes in this release include work from [@greatjourney589](https://github.com/greatjourney589) ([#8068](https://github.com/janhq/jan/pull/8068)), [@SnowingFox](https://github.com/SnowingFox) ([#8627](https://github.com/janhq/jan/pull/8627)) and [@orenyomtov](https://github.com/orenyomtov).

### Known issues

- **Auto compact** needs **Max Context Tokens** set for remote models; Jan does not detect a remote model's context window yet ([#9317](https://github.com/janhq/jan/issues/9317)).
- Local models do not run on Intel Macs, as in v0.8.5.

Full notes: https://github.com/janhq/jan/blob/main/docs/src/pages/changelog/2026-10-28-jan-v0.8.8.mdx

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/janhq/jan/compare/v0.8.7...v0.8.8
