- Uses electron 44.9.3
- Includes the Electron mitigation for the compromised eMudhra intermediate certificates [GHSA-jr5w-w6x2-84p9]
- Updates to [draw.io core 32.6.1](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio/blob/v32.6.1/ChangeLog). All changes from 32.5.5 to 32.6.1 are added in this build.

**Testing:**

Verified against the packaged, signed macOS build. Windows and Linux packages were verified from the produced release artifacts, their sizes and update manifests, rather than by running them.

Base checks

- Launch, open a file passed on the command line, add and edit shapes, change styles, undo and redo, copy and paste through the system clipboard, save, reopen, insert, rename and delete pages, and zoom
- Export to PNG, JPEG, SVG, PDF, XML and HTML from the command line, covering scale, border, transparency, cropping, page selection with -p and --size page, and PNG and PDF export from the app
- Diagram round trip in exported PNG, SVG and PDF files, including reopening an exported PDF and recovering both pages
- Mermaid and CSV import and the --layout and --normalize options from the command line
- Shape search, the stencils and shape palettes, the export dialogs and the print dialog
- Settings and the window position are kept after a restart
- Quick Look preview on macOS is registered for this build, and the Quick Look app extension is sandboxed and separately signed
- The macOS bundle is a universal binary signed with a Developer ID certificate under the hardened runtime, notarised and stapled
- The Electron security fuses are applied, so RunAsNode, the NODE_OPTIONS variable and the node inspect arguments are disabled and the app only loads from the asar
- 286 unit tests pass

Electron 44.9.3

- The app runs on Electron 44.9.3 with Chromium 152.0.7977.167; Electron lists 44.9.1 and later as patched for [GHSA-jr5w-w6x2-84p9]
- Local fonts are listed, and PDF and PNG export through the main process work on the new runtime

Checks around the changes

- Links that start with a slash are kept as they are in SVG exports from the app and from the command line, instead of becoming file:// links [jgraph/drawio#5809]
- Other links in SVG exports are written as before, and javascript: links are still not exported as runnable links
- The updated Citrix 2 shapes render, with no two connection points closer than 8 % of the shape
- The zoom, fit and close buttons of presentation mode respond to mouse clicks
- Reads, stats and writes of paths the user has not authorised are still refused, while an authorised file still reads and saves
- file: and javascript: links are still refused when a link is opened externally
- All update manifests name 32.6.1, with the Windows x64 and arm64 installers in separate manifests

release.name: Pomodoist v1.1.7
release.body: # Pomodoist 1.1.7 — Every action. A little easier. Pomodoist 1.1.7 makes everyday task management more comfortable, with a refreshed Quick Add experience, a detailed task creation editor, contextual keyboard hints, and more ways to personalize your workflow. This release also brings Pomo to large Apple widgets and improves startup and focus-session reliability. ## Quick Add, refined - On mobile, Quick Add opens as a compact bottom sheet. Swipe up to expand it while keeping your draft and selection intact. - Adjust your Pomodoro estimate directly inside the form using swipe gestures, arrow controls, or direct number entry. See the estimated focus time and clear a manual estimate when needed. - Refined input, toolbar, and description layouts make better use of the available space. - Improved the desktop Quick Add window's sizing and lifecycle. ## A detailed task creation editor - Add a description and attach files while creating a task. - Select assignees when creating tasks in shared projects. - See attachment errors and retry unfinished uploads without creating the task again. ## Contextual keyboard hints - Hold **⌘ on macOS** or **Ctrl on Windows and Linux** to reveal shortcuts available in the current context. - Discover commands in navigation, task views, menus, and dialogs. - Focus hints include both available Focus shortcuts. - Added a configurable shortcut for showing or hiding Pomo. ## Mobile task swipes - **Swipe right** to reveal the **Focus** button. - **Swipe left** to reveal the **Delete** button. - Tap the revealed button to perform the action. - Restore a deleted task with **Undo**. Recurring tasks retain their occurrence and series deletion choices. ## Pomo in Apple widgets - Large Apple widgets now include Pomo poses that reflect focus, breaks, and activity. - State changes use gentle transitions and respect Reduce Motion. - Improved widget snapshots, localization, and privacy handling. - Added Apple Watch navigation from widget links to the corresponding task, habit, day, and progress views. ## macOS menu bar timer styles Choose between two timer appearances: - **Old:** an outlined circle followed by the countdown. - **New:** a stopwatch icon followed by the countdown. The timer remains available in the menu bar while you work in other apps. ## Device settings through MCP Connected MCP agents can now read and update supported appearance settings and keyboard shortcuts on a selected, signed-in, online Pomodoist device. - Adjust themes, interface appearance, and supported shortcuts through your existing MCP connection. - Apply changes to the selected device. - Conflicting or unsupported settings return an error instead of silently replacing another configuration. - Updated the OpenClaw integration configuration and documentation for the new tools. ## Reliability and fixes - Keep the application shell visible while local data is being prepared. - Run recurring-task preparation in the background so it does not hold up local startup. - Preserve synchronization state across account token refreshes. - Preserve Focus updates received during startup. - Correct paused-interval finalization and focus-time accounting when ending a session. - Strengthen handling of concurrent Focus operations and repeated requests. - Improve task details, calendar, search, and navigation layouts. - Update translations and accessibility behavior across the affected interfaces. ## Maintenance - Added backend migrations and MCP tools for device settings. - Corrected Cloud backend configuration and updated app-settings and Android workflow checks. - Expanded automated coverage for Quick Add, task creation, shortcuts, widgets, account lifecycle, and Focus transitions. **Self-hosted installations:** deploy the matching backend migrations and updated functions before enabling the new MCP device-settings capabilities. [Full changelog](https://github.com/Kabanya/Pomodoist/compare/v1.1.6...v1.1.7)

# Release v0.102.3001.0

This hotfix release addresses crashes in File Locksmith and Quick Accent. See the [v0.102.2933.0 release notes](https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/releases/tag/v0.102.2933.0) for the full list of changes in PowerToys v0.102.

## Installer Hashes

| Description | Filename | SHA256 |
| --- | --- | --- |

| Per user - ARM64 | [PowerToysUserSetup-0.102.3001.0-arm64.exe][ptUserArm64] | `074208C93541BE77BB6E875D436A8A765E21649F2613196CEE62D9CA936611F2` |

## Highlights

This patch contains two fixes since the previous stable release.

### File Locksmith

- Fixed crashes when File Locksmith encounters a stalled file-handle scan, including crashes after the scan completes, in [#51507](https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/pull/51507).

### Quick Accent

- Fixed Quick Accent crashes when using arrow-key activation after changing languages or switching from a shorter character list, in [#51583](https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/pull/51583).

release.name: OBS Studio 33.0.1
release.body:
33.0.1 Hotfix Changes
---------------------

* Fixed a crash on startup when logged into a service integration [WizardCM] ([#554](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-browser/pull/554))
* Fixed a crash when logging into the Twitch integration [WizardCM] ([#14072](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/14072))
* Fixed a deadlock when logging into the YouTube integration [WizardCM] ([#556](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-browser/pull/556))
* Fixed a race condition where browser panels could end up with incorrectly sized content [WizardCM] ([#558](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-browser/pull/558))
* Fixed a memory leak when using the image slideshow source [prgmitchell] ([#14078](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/14078))
* Fixed plugins failing to load on Flatpak [FiniteSingularity] ([#14103](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/14103))
* Fixed Plugin Manager not prompting for save after a change until the dialog is re-opened [Warchamp7] ([#14112](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/14112))

33.0 New Features
-----------------

* Updated CEF from 127/6533 to 150/7871 [WizardCM] ([#13900](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13900))
  + This is a massive update to the underlying framework used for browser sources and docks from the July 2024 release to September 2026
  + All of this work is on the backend and should be invisible to users. Please be sure to report any new weirdness or problems you run into with browser sources!
* Complete overhaul to plugin loading [FiniteSingularity/PatTheMav] ([#13594](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13594))
  + First-party plugins are now in a new folder named core
  + Third-party plugins have an updated installation location and folder structure
  + Existing third-party plugins will continue to load from the legacy locations until OBS Studio 34.0
  + More information is available in our [knowledge base article](https://obsproject.com/kb/legacy-plugin-locations)
* Improved how source snapping works in the preview [Warchamp7] ([#12298](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/12298))
  + New visual indicator added
  + Sources now snap along the entire axis instead of only when directly touching
  + Sources no longer snap to hidden sources
* Improved behavior of spinboxes for number values [Warchamp7] ([#12337](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/12337))
  + Typing is no longer mysteriously blocked in some situations
  + Numbers are no longer cut off in some situations
  + Values now update only after pressing Enter and Enter does not close the window
  + Holding Shift + Up/Down now advances multiple steps at a time
  + Dragging the cursor inside the input but outside the text itself now works properly
* Enabled NVENC on Arm64 [RytoEX] ([#13827](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13827))

33.0 Changes
------------

* Added a check for encoders being missing when loading a profile [derrod] ([#11340](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/11340))
* Added support for newest NVIDIA Broadcast SDKs for NVIDIA Audio Effects and Video Effects [pkviet] ([#13838](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13838))
* Added hotkeys for controlling audio monitoring of a source [Warchamp7] ([#13599](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13599))
* Changed Safe Mode to not start WebSocket Server [FiniteSingularity/RytoEX] ([#13984](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13984))
* Fixed issues with groups in Studio Mode [Warchamp7] ([#11092](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/11092))
  + Fixed moving sources inside a group causing them to glitch out in Program
  + Fixed moving sources inside a group showing up live in Program
* Adjusted naming of Window Capture methods on Windows [Penwy] ([#12047](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/12047))
* Improved detection of fullscreen games for Game Capture [Kira-NT] ([#10880](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/10880))
* Improved transparency handling for macOS Screen Capture [jcm93] ([#13030](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13030))
* Scaled simple output recording audio bitrate by channel count [nickvonkaenel] ([#13311](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13311))
* Removed support for Ubuntu 24.04 

33.0 Bug Fixes
--------------

* Added a startup error if obs-transitions failed to load [notr1ch] ([#13321](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13321))
* Improved file splitting for Hybrid MP4/MOV [derrod] ([#13386](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13386))
* Fixed outputs getting stuck running when a bad rescale output resolution is set [suogesi] ([#13375](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13375))
* Fixed monitoring icon state getting desynced when using third-party tools or websockets [prgmitchell] ([#13822](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13822))
* Fixed a crash on macOS 27.2 when starting OBS Studio [RytoEX] ([#14070](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/14070))
* Fixed potential crash when shader cache file is invalid [notr1ch] ([#13538](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13538))
* Fixed a potential crash on Linux when USB mic is removed [R0te/RytoEX] ([#13922](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13922))
* Fixed a potential crash when renaming a source with the Add Source window open [Warchamp7] ([#13800](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13800))
* Fixed a potential deadlock during video/audio tasks [exeldro] ([#13579](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13579))
* Fixed an issue with B-frame offset calculation in AMF that could cause streams to disconnect [lexano-ivs] ([#13762](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13762))
* Fixed PipeWire screencast sources being duplicated in studio mode [tytan652] ([#13673](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13673))
* Fixed a potential crash when switching off a newly created profile [Warchamp7] ([#13182](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13182))
* Fixed a source toolbar crash when source type is missing [Penwy] ([#13539](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13539))
* Fixed profile import failing on paths with a trailing slash [Ushkalovk] ([#13863](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13863))

33.0 Developer Information
--------------------------

* Added frontend event and output signal for replay buffer saving [Penwy] ([#8955](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/8955))
* Added guidance regarding the theme system to the top of all theme files [Warchamp7] ([#13733](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13733))
* Added ability to set a file extension filter for OBS_PATH_FILE_SAVE path types [FiniteSingularity] ([#10190](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/10190))
* Added obs_frontend_is_safe_mode for first-party plugins
  + Third-party plugins are not loaded at all in Safe Mode
* Added versions to Flatpak plugin extension point [tytan652] ([#13735](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13735))
* Added obs_canvas_video_active() to check if the video of a canvas is active [exeldro] ([#13110](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13110))
* The minimum supported versions of Visual Studio, Windows SDK, and clang-format have been increased. Previous versions may continue to work, but will no longer be tested/supported. It is recommended that build environments are kept up-to-date with the project's toolchain.
  + Changed Windows builds to use Visual Studio 2026 and SDK 26100 [RytoEX] ([#13543](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13543))
  + Changed clang-format version used to 22.1.3 [PatTheMav] ([#13549](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13549))
* Changed obs_canvas_reset_video() to allow resetting a canvas's video when any other canvas's video is active, but not its own video [exeldro] ([#13110](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13110))
* Updated libnsgif to 1.0.0 [RytoEX] ([#11178](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/11178))
  + This is a breaking change for any plugins using libobs/graphics gs_image_file
* Clarified documentation for obs_module_unload [notr1ch] ([#13327](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13327))
* Required MbedTLS 3 and exclude 4 or later [tytan652] ([#13799](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13799))
* Removed support for FFmpeg 6.x and 7.x [RytoEX] ([#13964](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13964))
* Removed support for Qt 6.4-6.9 [RytoEX] ([#13969](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13969))
* Fixed repeated preview enable/disables not working [WarmUpTill] ([#12580](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/12580))
* Only emit core signal handlers for public canvases [tt2468] ([#13574](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13574))
* Deprecated unused hidden API for sources [derrod] ([#13122](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13122))
* Deprecated APIs for audio source monitoring_type [Warchamp7] ([#13599](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13599))
  + This is replaced by a new monitoring_enabled boolean

release.name: OpenChamber v2.5.3: Agents ship the icons too
release.body:
### New

- **Snippets:** save a message, a piece of selected text or your draft as a snippet from its menu or the `#` picker. In Settings you can rename a snippet, move it between project and global, and preview what it expands to.
- **Images:** agents can generate images with an image model you pick in Settings > General > OpenChamber Tools. The pictures show in the chat with a download button. Off by default.
- **Auto-review:** the review loop keeps going when you close the tab or lock the phone. It stops after five rounds, notifies you once when it ends, and a disputed result shows both positions in place.
- Header tabs: a new option keeps separate tabs for each project and worktree, and shows the tabs of the place you are in.
- Agents: an agent can wait on its pull request and wakes up when a check fails or passes, someone comments, or it is merged. The composer shows the pull request with Stop watching.
- Sidebar: pin a worktree from its menu to keep it on top. "Name worktrees by branch" in the display menu shows the branch first.
- Terminal: a tab closes when its shell or action exits. Turn it off in Settings > General > Terminal to keep the output.
- Drafts: a new session shows "N drafts" when other drafts wait in the same folder, to open or discard them.
- Dictation: Whisper large-v3 turbo and Qwen3-ASR join the local models, the dictation language helps them recognize short phrases, and "Fix misheard words" can clean up the text with the Small Model.
- Appearance: Interface font weight under Density & type, from Regular to Strong.
- Usage: the OpenCode Go page shows your OpenCode Console budgets.
- The app tells a small joke now and then: in the new-session heading, on a clean Git panel, after a late-night push. Pushes and merges throw confetti.

### Improvements

- Sidebar: each row shows what it is on the left and its state on the right, project headers read as sections, and times and branches are easier to read. A worktree is named by its task, never by one of its sessions.
- Sidebar: Track and Done sit only on rows that are a work of their own, and a fork is a work of its own.
- New session: the first message shows at once while the session is created, and a second Enter cannot start a second session (thanks to @yulia-ivashko).
- Work Status: the card stays beside Files, Changes or the browser when the window has room for both.
- Themes: secondary text, links and quotes are readable in every built-in theme, and dark themes keep secondary text quieter than the body.
- Files: document toolbars share one look and keep their buttons in place, and Files can comment on a whole file from its toolbar.
- Files: an open file or plan updates as soon as it changes on disk.
- Composer: `@` session search keeps matching across the words of a title.
- Small Model: a session on a small model such as DeepSeek or GLM flash keeps side work on that model.
- Worktrees: an issue worktree keeps the agent's branch name with the issue number in front, such as `fix/5747-stale-favorite-models`.

### Fixes

- Providers: connecting with an API key or OAuth works on the first try.
- Sessions: while a session runs in a folder with many sessions, the app no longer sends about a gigabyte an hour to OpenCode.
- Git: GitHub Enterprise and self-hosted GitLab behind a company certificate connect.
- Windows: upgrading OpenCode from the app no longer leaves OpenCode broken until a reinstall.
- Worktrees: deleting a worktree that sits on main no longer offers to delete main (thanks to @yulia-ivashko).
- Sessions: a session moved to another folder leaves no copy behind (thanks to @yulia-ivashko), and permission cards reach a session the agent moved mid-turn (thanks to @mossgowild).
- Sidebar: sessions in work outside your projects stay in In work (thanks to @alohaninja).
- Sidebar: a click anywhere on a row opens it, and a dragged session lands only in the folder under the pointer.
- Issues and PRs: a folder with several GitHub checkouts shows the list instead of a validation error (thanks to @guidan-nick).
- Desktop: a notification for another instance opens in the window that shows it (thanks to @timothywang21).
- Desktop: the update download progress stops at 100% (thanks to @bashrusakh).
- Desktop: the dock badge counts only chats the sidebar shows.
- Browser: an app in the agent's hidden tab runs at full speed.
- Settings/Providers: a custom provider kept in `opencode.jsonc` can be edited (thanks to @yulia-ivashko).
- Skills: turning a skill off works in projects with non-Latin folder names (thanks to @yulia-ivashko).
- Plugins: enable and disable rules in the plugin list no longer show as broken plugins.
- Chat: a link to a folder opens it in Finder (thanks to @yulia-ivashko).
- Chat: reference chips no longer cut off letters.
- Models: the favorite-model shortcut skips favorites whose provider is disconnected.
- Header: the session menu offers Move to project when session tabs are off.
- Composer: the cross in the drafts menu discards the draft instead of opening it.
- Comments: the whole-file comment field opens where you are in a long file.
- Folder trust: the app asks again when a local file a trusted plugin imports changes.
- Web: a page whose first load failed retries instead of staying empty.
- CLI: `openchamber serve` started from the app's terminal serves its own build.

### Misc

- Bundled OpenCode updated to 2.2.0, now the minimum supported version.
- Git library updated past four published security advisories.
- Desktop: Help > Suggest a Feature opens a feature request.

release.body:
# OpenWhispr 1.11.0

Teams can now share a dictionary, the assistant can follow skills you keep for recurring work, and a bunch of new models.

## 🌟 Highlights

- **📚 Shared team dictionary** — Business and Enterprise members get their team's words in dictation and meeting notes. Your own words still come first.
- **🧩 Skills** — Save instructions for recurring work in Integrations → Skills. The assistant picks a fitting skill on its own.
- **🤖 New models** — GPT-6.1 Sol, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Claude 5.5 on Bedrock, Gemma 4, Qwen3.8 and more. Older models keep working if you already use them.
- **🏢 Workspace switcher** — Switch workspaces and invite people from the sidebar. Your account now lives under your avatar in the top bar.
- **⚡ Whisper GPU fallback** — Whisper checks that CUDA or Vulkan actually started and falls back to CPU if not.


## 🛠 Fixes

- The app now starts after a second account signs in on the same device.
- On macOS, slow apps get your transcript, not your old clipboard. On Windows, AltGr no longer triggers Ctrl+Alt hotkeys.
- Meeting transcripts survive recording again, uploaded audio lands in the Transcript tab, and meeting prompts show up when they should.
- Dictionary sync no longer drops words on a new device, and moved folders keep their chats.
- Linux: paste works in Omarchy agent terminals, and Hyprland configs are written safely.

Full details in the [changelog](https://github.com/OpenWhispr/openwhispr/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#1110---2026-10-29).

repository.description: An open-source, privacy-first, self-hosted knowledge workspace where humans and AI agents work together 开源、隐私优先、自托管的知识工作空间，让人与智能体在此协作

license.name: GNU Affero General Public License v3.0

release.name: v3.8.9
release.body:
## Upgrade notice

Document titles can now include `/`. Use the new version to open and edit these documents. We recommend updating the devices that access the same data and checking that your plugins are compatible, to avoid older versions overwriting your changes. See [the compatibility details](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/19938).

## Overview

This release adds support for `/` in document titles and improves mind maps, database automations, mobile editing, and file change detection.

### Mind maps and editing

Mind maps gain themes, global styling, node selection and clipboard operations, improved summaries, and list-style editing interactions.

Tables support adjustable row heights, with improvements to cell activation, text formatting performance, and Markdown list copying and export.

### Databases and navigation

Database automations support collecting block references, attribute name substring and regex matching, and subdocument depth limits.

Backlinks can be filtered by database fields, new database items have configurable opening behavior, and mobile documents can display backlinks at the bottom.

### Platforms and reliability

This release improves iOS text selection and editing, mobile search navigation, sync progress and cancellation, and file change detection for snapshots, sync, and restoration.

It also adds Windows title bar overlay, macOS system proxy detection, TIFF previews, and custom lock screen wallpapers, and updates runtimes and CA certificates.

## Changelogs

Below are the detailed changes in this version.

### Enhancement

* [Improve Markdown list formatting when copying and exporting](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/12192)
* [Support `/` in document titles](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/19938)
* [Improve editing, database view, and search performance](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20692)
* [Support hiding parent paths in embedded block breadcrumbs](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20698)
* [Support pinning agent sessions](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20699)
* [Support maximizing and restoring PDF panes across platforms](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20701)
* [Support selecting, copying, cutting and pasting mind map nodes](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20703)
* [Improve mind map toolbar grouping and narrow layouts](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20723)
* [Improve table cell activation and context menus](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20728)
* [Improve mind map summary connectors and creation previews](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20732)
* [Support moving document tabs back to the main window](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20735)
* [Support closing detached windows with their last tab](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20736)
* [Improve performance when formatting text in pasted tables](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20751)
* [Support limiting subdocument depth in database automation scopes](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20753)
* [Support backlinks at the bottom of documents on mobile](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20756)
* [Improve sync checkout progress and cancellation](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20763)
* [Support TIFF image previews](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20764)
* [Improve database auto-collection with attribute name substring and regex matching](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20781)
* [Support clearing recent document history](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20785)
* [Improve mouse side button navigation](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20789)
* [Support custom lock screen wallpaper](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20797)
* [Support mind map themes and global styling](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20800)
* [Support macOS system network proxy detection](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20801)
* [Support filtering backlinks by database fields](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20802)
* [Improve mind map summary creation from selected nodes](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20803)
* [Support resizing table row heights](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20805)
* [Improve combining block references with inline code formatting](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20822)
* [Improve dock bar visibility when floating side panels are expanded](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20833)
* [Improve mobile search result navigation and keyword highlighting](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20834)
* [Improve loading indicators with theme-customizable fading rings](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20835)
* [Improve asset link parsing for internal previews](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/pull/20839)
* [Improve file change detection for snapshots, sync, and restoration](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20861)
* [Improve iOS text selection and editing](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20865)
* [Support title bar overlay on Windows](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20870)
* [Support configurable opening after creating database items](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20880)
* [Improve list-style editing interactions in mind maps](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20893)
* [Support collecting block references through database automation](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20907)
* [Improve LaTeX math delimiter compatibility for pasting and importing](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/21023)
* [Support extracting embedded PDF images with the AI agent](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/21050)

### Bugfix

* [Copied code blocks use fences shorter than embedded backtick sequences](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20704)
* [Inline memo content appears in dynamic block reference text](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20788)

### Refactor

* [Improve AI data storage consistency by consolidating workspace instructions](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20768)
* [Upgrade Electron, Go and CA certificates to distrust compromised eMudhra intermediates](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20780)
* [Improve Android file traversal with a pure Go implementation and diagnostics](https://github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/issues/20874)

repository.description: Orca is the place for working with a fleet of agents (e.g. Grok Bot, Claude Code). Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.
repository.name: orca

release.name: v1.4.245
release.body:
## A faster Orca, plugins & background computer use ⚡

- ⚡ **A faster Orca:** Launch smoothly with hundreds of chats, with less lag as you type and switch tabs.
- 🧩 **Customize Orca** with icon themes, syntax highlighting and custom editors.
- 🖱️ **Keep working** while agents use Chrome, Blender and other Mac apps in the background.
- 🎙️ **Dictate on your phone** and see your words as you speak.
- 💬 **Try the new Chat UI:** Search for “Chat UI” in Settings to turn it on, then right-click a tab to switch live between Chat UI and TUI.

## Highlights

- **A faster Orca:** Fast app with hundreds of chats. Typing stays more responsive, and hidden chats do less work while you use other tabs.
- **Plugins:** Add icon themes, syntax highlighting and custom editors from Settings → Plugins. Community publishing is coming soon, so you’ll be able to share your own plugins.
- **Background computer use on Mac:** Let agents work in Chrome, Blender and other apps while you keep using your mouse and keyboard. Orca’s in-app browser already works in the background; now computer use does too. Some actions still need the app brought forward.
- **Chats:** Enjoy a very polished Chat UI, send again after Stop, and preview links in chat. Search for “Chat UI” in Settings to turn it on, and right-click a tab to switch live between Chat UI and TUI.
- **Terminals:** Set a running terminal limit for each computer in Settings → Terminal → Advanced.
- **WSL:** Stopped distros stay stopped until you choose Start. Terminals remember their folder.
- **Browser:** Press Cmd+Opt+B on Mac for a browser split. Send shorter annotation feedback, now with pasted images.
- **Workspaces:** Your workspace name becomes its branch name again. Source Control actions get Model and Effort controls.
- **Phone:** See dictation as you speak, and read clearer code, tables and diagrams.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **New terminal host:** This release starts a fresh terminal host for new terminals. Terminals already open before the update keep running on the previous host and stay attached. The new running terminal limit setting needs the new host, and so do fixes such as the ble.sh startup fix and lighter process checks on macOS. Those apply to terminals you open after updating.
- **Plugins are on by default:** Installing a plugin, including from an `orca://plugins` link, only opens a review screen first. Plugins that run code ask for your consent before they install, and once approved they run with full access to your computer.
- **Running terminal limit:** The default now follows each computer: half of its system terminal limit, up to 4096, or 256 as before when Orca can’t read that limit. A value you set in Settings or with an environment variable takes priority. Raising or lowering it never closes running terminals. A remote server running an older Orca keeps working, but the limit can’t be changed there until it updates.
- **Chat naming:** Chats are now named by their own agent and account by default. A naming agent, custom command or arguments you saved before keep working, and the naming agent choice moved under Advanced in Settings → Chat → Chat naming.
- **Codex history across accounts:** A new switch, Settings → Agents → Share Codex history across accounts, is on by default and keeps today’s behavior. With it on, history from Orca’s managed accounts now also shows up in your own ~/.codex when you switch back to system default. Turning it off stops new sharing and removes nothing. On an SSH or WSL host running an older Orca, the switch stays disabled until that host updates.
- **Codex on macOS and Linux:** Orca now starts Codex with its paste guess turned off, so prompts typed from a phone or another client send instead of staying in the composer. Real pastes still arrive as pastes.
- **Computer use on a Mac:** Agents now act in the background by default. Agents can still ask for the old foreground mode with `--restore-window`, which drags into Chromium and Electron apps still need.
- **Browser annotations:** Send and Copy now give agents a short summary per note. Check **Include page details** in the Send menu to get the old full output; the choice lasts for that browser pane.
- **Workspace branch names:** A name you type for a new workspace is used as its branch again, even when Auto-rename branch from work is on. Auto-rename only replaces names Orca made up.
- **Automations:** Agents started by an automation skip their CLI’s startup update prompt, so the prompt can’t swallow the task. Agents you start yourself are unchanged.
- **Source Control actions:** Model and effort flags saved in an action’s Arguments move into the new Model and Effort controls when Orca loads; other Arguments stay as they are. A phone or remote server on an older Orca may launch these actions with a different model or effort until it updates.
- **New shortcuts:** Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+X opens Plugins (outside text fields), and Cmd+Opt+B on macOS opens a browser tab in a split to the right. Cmd+Opt+B can be changed in Settings → Keyboard.
- **Known limitation, downgrading:** If you go back to v1.4.244, custom model and effort choices on Source Control AI actions reset to the agent’s defaults, and updating again won’t bring them back.

---

## Product experience

### Native chat

*No more startup freeze with many chats, link previews, naming with the chat’s own agent, and a working Send after Stop.*

* Show chats as Interrupted or Done at startup without reading their history, so Orca no longer freezes after launch with hundreds of chats by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32146
* Show hover cards for GitHub PR and issue links in chats by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35199
* Show preview cards for web links in chats, never fetching private network addresses by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35221
* Name each chat with its own agent and account by default, with other naming agents under Advanced by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32106
* Let the next message go through after Stop force-kills a chat’s agent by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34653
* Keep a huge unbroken paste from freezing a chat by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36031
* Run launcher Commands like `op run -- codex` for every agent in chats by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35592
* Leave Claude plan mode when you approve a plan by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34549
* Resume a chat with a saved effort on Claude Code versions that predate --effort by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35878
* Keep the model options a chat accepted in what it shows and sends by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31208
* Keep a chat’s option controls working while its model list refreshes by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31927
* Handle large pastes in chat goal mode by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34654
* Order queued chat turns without rescanning the transcript by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34945
* Stop resting chats from delaying native command menus by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35069
* Recover from OpenCode failures in chats by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35247
* Keep models missing from a provider’s list available in chats by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35266
* Process image-heavy transcript runs once by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35572
* Reopen an old tool run without jumping to a stale scroll position by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35866
* Stop re-rendering chat composer controls on every keystroke by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35913
* Do less work for hidden chats and tab updates by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36047
* Keep the chat session record file within the file name length limit by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36056
* Make Settings permission menus match the chat permission picker by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36104
* Stop the saved chat status writer from remembering every closed chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36105
* Keep transcripts from re-rendering on status-only updates by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36141
* Keep chats ended with Stop readable after downgrading to v1.4.244 by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36142
* Skip the WSL distro walk for chat transcripts on this computer by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36152

### Plugins

*Icon themes, syntax packs and custom editors, one Plugins list with one-step install, and quick access from the status bar.*

* Plugin Alpha: icon themes, syntax packs and custom editors, one Plugins list with one-step install, and `orca://plugins` links by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35470
* Open Plugins from a status bar button or Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+X by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36153
* Show one Plugins list with Installed badges, inline switches, install-state filters, category chips and plain wording about trusted code by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36100
* Show the Plugins catalog in four columns with clear Show all and See all links by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35849
* Make Try it apply the plugin instead of opening its page by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35846
* Treat self-hosted plugin repository paths that differ in case as different repositories by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35640
* Stop an update already in progress when you turn off plugin auto-update by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35642
* Keep the Try it and Switch back toasts up long enough to click by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35650
* Apply a one-mode theme visibly when you install it by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35674
* Use one loader for plugin panels and editors, and keep suspended panels marked failed by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35680
* Keep unsaved edits in plugin binary editors across renames, reloads and duplicate tabs by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35698
* Load installed plugins whose minimum Orca version predates their fields by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35756
* Keep plugin panels within the sidebar’s height by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36085
* Cap the plugin preview cache to the current version by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36089
* Count plugin installs from Orca’s public catalogs by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36132
* Reload the active icon theme after a plugin update by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36151

### Browser

*A browser split shortcut, shorter annotation feedback with pasted images, and SSH proxies that work in the browser.*

* Open a browser tab in a split to the right with a shortcut (Cmd+Opt+B on macOS) by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35994
* Send compact annotation feedback by default, with an Include page details checkbox for the full detail by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35990
* Paste images into annotation comments and send them to the agent by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36004
* Reach sites through the SSH host’s proxy in an SSH workspace’s browser by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36022
* Keep your chosen default browser profile after a restart or update by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35991
* Open Orca’s own buttons and links according to the open-links-in-Orca setting by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35992
* Show the page’s viewport size while you resize a browser pane by @chucoding in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31145
* Make Next.js Server Actions work through a worktree’s *.orca.localhost address by @promptprobe in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/14562
* Check Chrome Web Store redirects before following them by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35286
* Contain malformed browser automation messages by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35291
* Skip unused frame scans when checking site permissions by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35326
* Reuse tab snapshots when listing tabs for extensions by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35327
* Release startup data from abandoned extension native helpers by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35344
* Avoid repeated cleanup scans of extension native helper ports by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35346
* Cap copied header data from extension native helpers by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35359
* Close extension popups that close themselves when they lose focus by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35360
* Cap pending writes to extension native helpers by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35362
* Release used buffers from extension native helpers by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35368
* Skip converting outdated page snapshots by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35377
* Load pages through a server set to “Server (streamed)” even when it can’t stream by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35381
* Keep popups opened by a page in the same browser session by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35397
* Close Find on a full page navigation in client-hosted browsers by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35692
* Refuse a 21st page annotation with a visible limit instead of dropping the oldest by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35979
* Print `orca console` and `orca network` entries in text mode and respect --limit by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35981
* Give agent device and viewport `--mobile` settings touch input and a coarse pointer by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35982
* Import a cookie file into a client-hosted browser under a remote server by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35989
* Keep agent clicks on target when a page changes, with agent-browser 0.39.4 by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36007
* Return `orca tab list` at once when a worktree has no saved browser tab by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36017
* Preview HTML files over 512 KiB from paired hosts by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36021

### Agent launch, status & accounts

*Mac apps driven in the background, Codex history you can keep apart per account, and steadier Grok, Antigravity and Mobile Emulator support.*

repository.name: photocraft
repository.description: PhotoCraft: An open-source, photo editor written by scratch in pure Rust

release.name: PhotoCraft v0.17.0
release.body:
## What's Changed
* Package: never overwrite one link's copy with another, list a missing link once by @softwaregames1 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9185
* Fix CPU pixel grid stroke width on HiDPI displays by @ssh-den in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9199
* Image Rotation › Arbitrary turns unlinked layer masks (#9201) by @davidmann4 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9203
* fix(cms): ignore tags inside .look XML comments (#9109) by @DuBearte in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9210
* fix(cms): headerless .3dl tables read on at least the 12-bit scale (#9121) by @DuBearte in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9215
* fix(engine): turn a shape's gradient stroke with the canvas (#9239) by @davidmann4 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9240
* fix(ui): Hue/Saturation's spectrum bars stretch with the panel (#9242) by @DuBearte in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9250
* fix(ui): a swatch click recolours selected type and shapes with any tool (#9238) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9253
* feat: New Document can start as an artboard (#9086) by @DuBearte in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9258
* Crop: in Full Screen Mode Match Canvas is the black pasteboard (#9294) by @davidmann4 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9295
* Crop and Straighten Photos processes only the selection (#9297) by @davidmann4 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9298
* fix(algo): Dehaze leaves no bright halo beside dark objects (#9273) by @DuBearte in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9316
* fix(engine): defined and imported patterns survive a restart (#9317) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9318
* Paste: centre pixels copied from another document (#8945) by @DuBearte in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9353
* feat(ui): Browse… for the folders of Image Processor and Batch (#9357) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9360
* Tests: the smart filter stack-cache test runs in its own binary (#9376) by @davidmann4 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9377
* Reveal All: ignore erased, fully transparent pixels (#9379) by @davidmann4 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9380
* SVG: text reads each font file once instead of once per glyph (#9406) by @davidmann4 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9407
* Export Data Sets as Files keeps outputs in the chosen folder (#9420) by @davidmann4 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9422
* Plug-ins: refuse a manifest that declares a parameter twice (#9441) by @davidmann4 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9442
* Engine: assets_dir's doc comment back on assets_dir (#9390) by @davidmann4 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9391
* fix(atn): preserve unsupported event kinds by @justinjohn0306 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8509
* Kept composites follow the text gamma and free their memory; GPU timing survives an OOM retry (#8520, #8521) by @davidmann4 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8522
* Fix layout benchmark setup for preserved Smart Objects by @bommerts in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8664
* Regression tests for eight fixes merged without one by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8690
* Refuse .pcraft manifests with too many JSON values before parsing by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8893
* ora: test that Soft Light exports as svg:soft-light by @switch87 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9028
* Filter Gallery: ⌘+ / ⌘− / ⌘0 / ⌘1 zoom the preview, stepping like Liquify's by @andeecollard in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9107
* Channels panel: drag alpha channels to reorder them (#9163) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9168
* fix(ui): Save for Web reopens on the preview tab chosen last (#9174) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9178
* Codecs: save Amiga IFF (.iff) as 24-bit ILBM by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9080
* fix(cms): read UTF-16 LUT files by their byte-order mark by @bercedev in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9129
* fix(ui): Properties Transform shows a shape's path, not its stroke by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9181
* contributors: credit VoiceLessQ by display name by @VoiceLessQ in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9264
* Contributors: add my name (erenova) by @erenova in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9369
* ci(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 3 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8979
* Security: pin and verify the Windows signing client (#2936) by @Erica4fr in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/3938
* Migrate PhotoCraft to egui 0.37 by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9363
* feat(updates): add startup self-update prompt modal by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9322
* build: pin craft-update to craft-libs main (495e597) by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9548
* chore(deps): refresh safe dependency bumps by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9558
* chore: resolve SonarCloud maintainability issues by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9044
* Integration batch 8: 37 reviewed community PRs on main by @davidmann4 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9386
* Crop tool: right-click on a pending crop opens its menu: presets, overlays, Cancel and Crop (#6561) by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/6620
* codecs: read and write TIFF extra samples (spot and alpha channels) by @jasallen in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/7415
* perf(photomerge): track multiband timing and peak memory by @ersoynarin-code in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/7873
* PSD: type on a path opens on its path and saves back into the file's Txt2 (#7962) by @Higgs32584 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8175
* Raw: open lossy DNGs (floating-point JPEG XL raw data), and fall back to the JPEG XL preview, not the tiny thumbnail (fixes #8125) by @SBaksa in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8402
* Menu bar: Space no longer opens File › New after Alt+zoom, finishing #6256's fix (#7688) by @artman67 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8679
* fix(io): DDS export writes the document's alpha channel by @FinnNk in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8776
* Fix stacked brush-tip artifacts in hard-round presets by @wanikhawar in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8846
* PSD: recognise Photoshop's `MTrn` merged-transparency marker by @jasallen in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8877
* PSD: spot channels in Photoshop's polarity; PSDs from earlier PhotoCraft versions keep their ink by @jasallen in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8885
* fix(#9098): preserve PSD byte order in layered TIFF text descriptors by @ronibalthazar in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9128
* Rebuild the Histogram panel  by @mathildalabs in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9139
* Layered TIFF: write Photoshop's global layer mask block (#9095) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9148
* fix(cms): Resolve .cube files with a 1D shaper and a 3D table load (#9177) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9183
* fix(ui): the font menu opens on the current family's recent row (#9160) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9197
* fix(ui): Bevel & Emboss Highlight and Shadow Mode are separate dropdowns (#9368) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9370
* raw: a non-finite black level no longer panics the AHD demosaic by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9446
* raw: grouped 10/12/14-bit unpack, single-strip buffer kept, in-place undelta by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9449
* raw: block-wise final encode stage for the default rendering by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9452
* raw: develop_half, a fused half-size preview develop (part of #9433) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9454
* Add optional local models for subject matting and object selection by @mighty-programmer in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1199
* Art History Brush in the Y-group flyout by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1610
* Add intermediate UI scale presets between 100% and 125% by @WebWork-rrs in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/3316
* History panel: New Snapshot dialog and the first snapshot (#2966) by @itsF4LCON in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/3567
* Mixer Brush: render mixed paint during the stroke and commit the live result by @durtyrobbin in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/3627
* Integrations: wire Allow Agent Control and Control Port (#204) by @Erica4fr in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/4097
* Interface: Animation Effects follows the system setting, or is on or off by @JeremyYao in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/4573
* Camera Raw: Calibration panel, Auto, raw sidecars and live Camera Raw Defaults (FILE-215-11) by @FabioLissi in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/5128
* perf(algo): Content-Aware Scale 2x faster, within its P28 budget (#211) by @SckraT in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/5236
* Blend mode keys: Shift+Alt+letter picks a mode, as in Photoshop by @paulou-jpg in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/5478
* Mode dropdowns for Clone Stamp, Pattern Stamp, History Brush, Healing and Paint Bucket by @paulou-jpg in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/5504
* fix(zoom): Restore smooth wheel zoom by @sn-o-w in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/5547
* perf(camera-raw): develop the preview's per-pixel stages on the GPU (#6916) by @fjamesprice in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/6923
* feature: gradient paint to the shape tools, any shape can have a gradient stroke. by @deniskhud in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/7203
* Brush: large tips rasterize, accumulate and composite in parallel by @Unemars in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/7218
* Crop: Content-Aware Fill keeps the pixels a non-deleting crop hid (#8060) by @Higgs32584 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8179
* fix(xtask): derive scorecard corpus counts from pinned manifests by @Lucenx9 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8658
* io: TIFF alpha and spot channels, with PSD output unchanged by @jasallen in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8878
* fix(ui): Type options bar alignment follows the target paragraph by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9179
* Panels: move onto craft-ui's shared docking by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9366
* Panels: review follow-ups to the shared docking and egui 0.37 merges by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9575
* lint: clear new-code S8855/S8856/S8862/S1612/S7688/S7679 findings by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9576
* Panels: remove the old dock's drawing code by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9583

* ci: require nextest 0.9.150 by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9749
* refactor: shared module layout (craft-contrib#20) by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9758
* perf(selection): window marquee and lasso feather masks by @wanikhawar in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9794

* fix(ui): dropdown menus grow back after a search with no matches by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9849
* perf(save): faster .pcraft and PSD saves, byte-identical output by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9877

* Color panel: the Color Wheel fits the panel at its default height (#9394) by @davidmann4 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9395

release.name: DBX v0.6.62
release.body:
### 新功能

- 连接参数新增可视化编辑器：独立弹窗内搜索、编辑参数并查看说明，支持重复参数、原始文本模式和敏感值隐藏，通用 JDBC 连接可读取驱动属性元数据 (contributed by @zipg) (PR [#13892](https://github.com/t8y2/dbx/pull/13892))
- MySQL 数据导出新增「省略表名中的数据库前缀」选项，INSERT 语句中的表名不再携带 `db.` 前缀 (contributed by @yiqiui) (PR [#13601](https://github.com/t8y2/dbx/pull/13601))

### 改进

- Elasticsearch/EasySearch 的 REST 请求体支持 JSON 语言，提供语法高亮、嵌套折叠和语法诊断，执行内容保持不变 (contributed by @OOMEcho) (PR [#10749](https://github.com/t8y2/dbx/pull/10749))
- 数据网格底栏的选中统计精简为单项指标（默认求和），其余指标收进弹出面板，所选指标自动记住并在重启后沿用 (contributed by @zipg) (PR [#13951](https://github.com/t8y2/dbx/pull/13951))
- 更新被配置弹窗阻止时明确指出需要关闭的对话框名称（包括弹窗位于其他窗口的情况），不再显示笼统的「请先完成当前配置编辑」 (contributed by @zipg) (PR [#13907](https://github.com/t8y2/dbx/pull/13907))
- PostgreSQL 原生查询错误信息附带 SQLSTATE 错误码，便于对照定位问题 (contributed by @imcman) (PR [#13922](https://github.com/t8y2/dbx/pull/13922))
- 选择自定义或系统 Java 时，驱动管理对话框隐藏 Dbx 托管的 JRE 运行时列表，避免展示与当前选择矛盾的条目 (contributed by @yiqiui) (PR [#13949](https://github.com/t8y2/dbx/pull/13949))
- 侧边栏搜索结果不再显示原生作业和用户权限管理等管理入口节点 (contributed by @yaoxinghuo) (PR [#13916](https://github.com/t8y2/dbx/pull/13916))

### 修复

- 修复 JDBC 分页查询收尾时回滚 DROP TABLE、CREATE TABLE AS 等语句的问题，此前显示执行成功但改动实际未生效 (contributed by @dienaso) (PR [#13709](https://github.com/t8y2/dbx/pull/13709))
- 修复已知总行数大于已加载行数时首屏被误判为完整结果、「导出全部数据」只导出已加载页的问题 (contributed by @misxzaiz) (PR [#13878](https://github.com/t8y2/dbx/pull/13878))
- 修复 Windows ARM64 版打开查询页即因主线程栈溢出闪退（0xC00000FD）的问题 (contributed by @Acd-kk) (PR [#13918](https://github.com/t8y2/dbx/pull/13918))
- 修复 MySQL 导入 SQL 文件时文件内 `SET NAMES utf8` 将连接切换为三字节字符集、中文和 emoji 写入报 ERROR 1366 或变成 `????` 的问题 (contributed by @MomentarySixthSense) (PR [#13946](https://github.com/t8y2/dbx/pull/13946))
- 修复 MySQL 分区表生成数据时产生不属于任何分区的值、插入报 ERROR 1526 的问题 (contributed by @zipg) (PR [#13910](https://github.com/t8y2/dbx/pull/13910))
- 修复 MySQL 等无 schema 数据库在生成数据的外键参数中表和列下拉列表为空的问题 (contributed by @yiqiui) (PR [#13948](https://github.com/t8y2/dbx/pull/13948))
- 修复 Oracle US7ASCII 数据库中按 GBK 等历史编码存储的中文读取为 `????` 的问题，新增连接级遗留编码兼容选项 (contributed by @zipg) (PR [#13799](https://github.com/t8y2/dbx/pull/13799))
- 修复 Oracle 未安装 Spatial 组件时查询 SDO_GEOMETRY 表报 ORA-04067 的问题，改为以占位符读取几何列 (contributed by @jeff377) (PR [#13919](https://github.com/t8y2/dbx/pull/13919))
- 修复 Oracle 通过数据库链接（`TABLE@LINK` 及指向链接的同义词）查看表结构不显示列信息的问题 (contributed by @jeff377) (PR [#13758](https://github.com/t8y2/dbx/pull/13758))
- 修复 openGauss MySQL 兼容模式无法查看表索引的问题，限定名改用 textcat 拼接以兼容未开启 pipes_as_concat 的实例 (contributed by @thailoc-dev) (PR [#13932](https://github.com/t8y2/dbx/pull/13932))
- 修复 Spanner SEARCH 全文索引被渲染为 UNIQUE INDEX、生成 DDL 无法执行的问题 (contributed by @dienaso) (PR [#13931](https://github.com/t8y2/dbx/pull/13931))
- 修复达梦克隆表时确认的目标表名被强制转为大写的问题 (contributed by @zipg) (PR [#13909](https://github.com/t8y2/dbx/pull/13909))
- 修复表名为 apply 时被误当作 APPLY 表运算符、FROM apply 之后不再提示 WHERE 等子句关键字的问题 (contributed by @ericbyz) (PR [#13889](https://github.com/t8y2/dbx/pull/13889))
- 修复 JDBC 别名补全丢失表 schema、从错误的 schema 加载列的问题 (contributed by @zipg) (PR [#13861](https://github.com/t8y2/dbx/pull/13861))
- 修复 MCP 严格客户端因 Nacos 注册实例 metadata 以布尔 schema 发布而拒绝整个 tools/list 响应的问题 (contributed by @lcq928) (PR [#13893](https://github.com/t8y2/dbx/pull/13893))
- 修复 AI 插件工具待审批卡片被长回复滚出视野、找不到批准入口的问题，审批卡固定在输入框上方并在取消请求时同步清理 (contributed by @imcman) (PR [#13905](https://github.com/t8y2/dbx/pull/13905))
- 修复选中多条 SQL 执行后手动事务等无语句编号的结果不显示成功或失败标识的问题 (contributed by @Acd-kk) (PR [#13913](https://github.com/t8y2/dbx/pull/13913))
- 修复仅调整排版的内置 SQL 片段不再按当前数据库方言转换、SQL Server 下仍插入 LIMIT 语法的问题 (contributed by @seaways1015-afk) (PR [#13936](https://github.com/t8y2/dbx/pull/13936))
- 修复侧边栏搜索结果中的表首次展开无反应、下级对象不显示的问题 (contributed by @yiqiui) (PR [#13953](https://github.com/t8y2/dbx/pull/13953))
- 修复编辑或查看 Redis 连接时切换页签界面卡死的问题 (contributed by @onenewcode) (PR [#13863](https://github.com/t8y2/dbx/pull/13863))
- 修复 Redis 键列表后台补全类型和过期信息失败导致进行中的扫描中止的问题 (contributed by @Gaiokane) (PR [#13868](https://github.com/t8y2/dbx/pull/13868))
- 修复设置页无待保存改动时「应用并关闭」按钮置灰、看似无法关闭的问题 (contributed by @yiqiui) (PR [#13950](https://github.com/t8y2/dbx/pull/13950))
- 修复 PostGIS 空间字段提示文案换行导致表结构编辑器排版错位的问题 (contributed by @thailoc-dev) (PR [#13864](https://github.com/t8y2/dbx/pull/13864))

release.name: v0.106.1
release.body:
# v0.106.1
> [!IMPORTANT]
> This is a security release for the **server and Docker images**. If you run Trilium as a server, especially one reachable from the internet, update as soon as possible.

### 🔒 Security

1.  [Updated Node.js in the Docker images](https://github.com/TriliumNext/Trilium/issues/12223) to 24.22.1 (22.23.4 for the legacy image), taking in the Node.js security releases of 21 October 2026:
    1.  **Brotli decoder out-of-bounds write (CVE-2026-111497).** Trilium decompresses Brotli-encoded request bodies before authentication, so on earlier versions any client that could reach the server could send a malicious request. Outbound requests (link previews, image downloads, web search) were also affected through the responses they receive.
    2.  **Revoked eMudhra/emSign certificate authorities.** The certificate store bundled with Node.js trusted certificate authorities whose keys were compromised. This allowed a man-in-the-middle with the right network access to impersonate HTTPS servers that Trilium connects to (sync with another instance, link previews, LLM providers).
    3.  Other fixes to TLS, HTTP and DNS handling from the same Node.js release.

> [!TIP]
> If you enjoyed this release, consider showing a token of appreciation by:
> 
> *   Pressing the “Star” button on [GitHub](https://github.com/TriliumNext/Trilium) (top-right).
> *   Considering a one-time or recurrent donation to the [lead developer](https://github.com/eliandoran) via [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/eliandoran) or [PayPal](https://paypal.me/eliandoran).

release.body:
## Bug Fixes
- Gateway titles for a listing now ask once whether anything was recorded, instead of once per session.

### Install

Download from [usemagpie.ai](https://usemagpie.ai), or `curl -fsSL https://usemagpie.ai/install.sh | sh`. An installed magpie updates itself.

- **macOS (Apple Silicon):** `magpie-darwin-arm64.dmg`
- **macOS (Intel):** `magpie-darwin-amd64.dmg`
- **Windows:** `magpie-windows-amd64.exe` (ARM: `magpie-windows-arm64.exe`)
- **Linux:** `magpie-linux-amd64` / `magpie-linux-arm64` (needs GTK 3 and WebKitGTK 4.1)
- **Terminal only:** `magpie-cli-<os>-<arch>`
